questionText: 设$X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{m}$为来自二项分布总体$B(n,p)$的简单随机样本，$\bar{X}$和$S^{2}$分别为样本均值和样本方差，若$\bar{X}+k S^{2}$为$n p^{2}$的无偏估计量，则 k=___
analysisRich: 解 由题设知，$n p^{2}=E(\overline{X}+k S^{2})=E(\overline{X})+k E(S^{2}).$又$E(\overline{X})=E(X)=np,$$E(S^{2})=D(X)=np(1-p),$故有$n p^{2}=np+np(1-p)k$，解得 k=-1.

设总体 X的概率分布为：
X123
P1-θθ-θ2θ2
其中参数$\theta \in (0,1)$未知.以$N_{i}$表示来自总体$X$的简单随机样本（样本容量为$n$）中等于$i$的个数$(i = 1,2,3)$试求常数$a_{1},a_{2},a_{3}$，使$T = \sum_{i = 1}^{3}a_{i}N_{i}$为$\theta$的无偏估计量，并求$T$的方差.
analysisRich: 解 令$T = \sum_{i = 1}^{3} a_{i} N_{i}$为$\theta$的无偏估计量，则有$\theta = E (T) = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} a _ {i} E \left(N _ {i}\right).$由$N_{i}$的定义知，$N_{i}$服从二项分布，即$N_{1}\sim B(n,1 - \theta),N_{2}\sim B(n,\theta -\theta^{2}),N_{3}\sim B(n,\theta^{2})$，从而$E(N_{1}) = n(1 - \theta),E(N_{2}) = n(\theta -\theta^{2}),E(N_{3}) = n\theta^{2}$.代入（1）式得$\theta = a _ {1} n (1 - \theta) + a _ {2} n \left(\theta - \theta^ {2}\right) + a _ {3} n \theta^ {2},$整理得$0 = a _ {1} n + \left(a _ {2} n - a _ {1} n - 1\right) \theta + \left(a _ {3} n - a _ {2} n\right) \theta^ {2},$从而$a _ {1} n = 0, \quad a _ {2} n - a _ {1} n - 1 = 0, \quad a _ {3} n - a _ {2} n = 0,$解得$a_{1}=0,a_{2}=\frac{1}{n},a_{3}=\frac{1}{n}.$又由$N_{i}$的定义知，$N_{1}+N_{2}+N_{3}=n$，故$T = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} a _ {i} N _ {i} = \frac {1}{n} \left(N _ {2} + N _ {3}\right) = \frac {1}{n} \left(n - N _ {1}\right) = 1 - \frac {1}{n} N _ {1},$从而$D (T) = D \left(1 - \frac {1}{n} N _ {1}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} D \left(N _ {1}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \cdot n (1 - \theta) \theta = \frac {\theta (1 - \theta)}{n}.$综上所述，$a_{1}=0, a_{2}=\frac{1}{n}, a_{3}=\frac{1}{n}, D(T)=\frac{\theta(1-\theta)}{n}.$

questionText:
设总体 X的概率密度为$f ( x; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac{3 x^{2}}{\theta^{3}}, & 0 < x < \theta , \\ 0, & \mathrm {其 他}, \end{array} \right.$其中$\theta \in(0,+\infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本，令$T=\max \left\{X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}\right\}$.

I. 求 T的概率密度；

II. 确定 a，使得 aT为$\theta$的无偏估计.
answerRich: $(\mathrm {I}) f _ {T} (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {9 t ^ {8}}{\theta^ {9}}, & 0 < t < \theta , \\ 0, & \mathrm {其 他}; \end{array} \right. (\mathrm {I I}) a = \frac {1 0}{9}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）设$T$的分布函数为$F_{T}(t), T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t).$由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$为来自总体X的简单随机样本，故它们相互独立且与X同分布.从而$\begin{array}{l} F _ {T} (t) = P \left\{T \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant t, X _ {2} \leqslant t, X _ {3} \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant t \right\} \cdot P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant t \right\} \cdot P \left\{X _ {3} \leqslant t \right\} \\ = \left[ P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\} \right] ^ {3} = \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {3}, \\ \end{array}$其中$F_{X}(t)$为X的分布函数.

下面用两种方法求$f_{T}(t)$（法一）先求$F_{T}(t)$，再求导得到$f_{T}(t)$当$t < 0$时，$F_{X}(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x;\theta)\mathrm{d}x = 0.$于是$F_{T}(t) = [F_{X}(t)]^{3} = 0.$当 0≤t <$\theta$时，$F_{X}(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x;\theta)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{t}\frac{3x^{2}}{\theta^{3}}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{t^{3}}{\theta^{3}}.$于是$F_{T}(t)=[F_{X}(t)]^{3}=\frac{t^{9}}{\theta^{9}}.$当 t≥$\theta$时，$F_{X}(t)=1.$于是$F_{T}(t)=[F_{X}(t)]^{3}=1.$因此，$F _ {T} (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & t < 0, \\ \frac {t ^ {9}}{\theta^ {9}}, & 0 \leqslant t < \theta , \\ 1, & t \geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$综上所述，$T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t) = F_{T}^{\prime}(t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \frac{9t^{8}}{\theta^{9}}, & 0 < t < \theta , \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（法二）直接求导得到$f_{T}(t)$后再求解.$f _ {T} (t) = F _ {T} ^ {\prime} (t) = 3 F _ {X} ^ {\prime} (t) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2} = 3 f (t; \theta) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2}.$当$t < 0$时，$f(t; \theta) = 0.$于是$f_{T}(t) = 0.$当$0 \leqslant t < \theta$时，$F_{X}(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x; \theta)\mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{t} \frac{3x^{2}}{\theta^{3}}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{t^{3}}{\theta^{3}}.$于是$f _ {T} (t) = 3 f (t; \theta) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2} = 3 \cdot \frac {3 t ^ {2}}{\theta^ {3}} \cdot \left(\frac {t ^ {3}}{\theta^ {3}}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {9 t ^ {8}}{\theta^ {9}}.$当$t \geqslant \theta$时，$f(t; \theta) = 0.$于是$f_{T}(t) = 0.$综上所述，$T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \frac{9t^8}{\theta^9}, & 0 < t < \theta , \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问中所求结果知，$E (a T) = a E (T) = a \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} t f _ {T} (t) \mathrm {d} t = a \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} \frac {9 t ^ {9}}{\theta^ {9}} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {9 a}{1 0 \theta^ {9}} t ^ {1 0} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} = \frac {9}{1 0} a \theta .$要使$E(aT) = \theta$，则$\frac{9}{10} a\theta = \theta$，解得$a = \frac{10}{9}$.

因此，当$a=\frac{10}{9}$时，$aT$为$\theta$的无偏估计.

questionText: 设$( X_{1}, Y_{1}), ( X_{2}, Y_{2}), \cdots, ( X_{n}, Y_{n} )$为来自总体$N (\mu_{1}, \mu_{2}; \sigma_{1}^{2}, \sigma_{2}^{2}; \rho)$的简单随机样本，令$\theta=\mu_{1}-\mu_{2}, \bar{X}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} X_{i}, \bar{Y}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} Y_{i}, \hat{\theta}=\bar{X}-\bar{Y}$则（    )
analysisRich:
解 由于总体（X，Y）服从$N(\mu_{1},\mu_{2};\sigma_{1}^{2},\sigma_{2}^{2};\rho)$，故$X\sim N(\mu_{1},\sigma_{1}^{2}),Y\sim N(\mu_{2},\sigma_{2}^{2})$，从而$\bar{X}\sim$$N\left(\mu_{1},\frac{\sigma_{1}^{2}}{n}\right),\bar{Y}\sim N\left(\mu_{2},\frac{\sigma_{2}^{2}}{n}\right).$计算$E(\hat{\theta})$$E (\hat {\theta}) = E (\bar {X} - \bar {Y}) = E (\bar {X}) - E (\bar {Y}) = \mu_ {1} - \mu_ {2} = \theta .$因此，$\hat{\theta}$是$\theta$的无偏估计.

计算$D(\hat{\theta})$$D (\hat {\theta}) = D (\bar {X} - \bar {Y}) = D (\bar {X}) + D (\bar {Y}) - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (\bar {X}, \bar {Y}) = \frac {\sigma_ {1} ^ {2}}{n} + \frac {\sigma_ {2} ^ {2}}{n} - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (\bar {X}, \bar {Y}).$由于$\left(X_{1},Y_{1}\right), \left(X_{2},Y_{2}\right),\dots ,\left(X_{n},Y_{n}\right)$为简单随机样本，故它们相互独立，从而当$i\neq j$时，$X_{i}$与$Y_{j}$独立.于是，$\operatorname{Cov}(X_{i},Y_{i})=\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y),\operatorname{Cov}(X_{i},Y_{j})=0(i\neq j).$$\begin{aligned} \operatorname {C o v} (\bar {X}, \bar {Y}) &= \operatorname {C o v} \left(\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}}{n}, \frac {\sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} Y _ {j}}{n}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \operatorname {C o v} \left(X _ {i}, Y _ {j}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \cdot \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \operatorname {C o v} \left(X _ {i}, Y _ {i}\right) \\ &= \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \cdot n \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , Y)}{n}. \end{aligned}$因此，$D (\hat {\theta}) = \frac {\sigma_ {1} ^ {2}}{n} + \frac {\sigma_ {2} ^ {2}}{n} - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (\bar {X}, \bar {Y}) = \frac {\sigma_ {1} ^ {2}}{n} + \frac {\sigma_ {2} ^ {2}}{n} - \frac {2}{n} \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = \frac {\sigma_ {1} ^ {2} + \sigma_ {2} ^ {2} - 2 \rho \sigma_ {1} \sigma_ {2}}{n}.$应选C.

questionText: 设$X_{1}, X_{2}$为来自总体$N\left(\mu ,\sigma^{2}\right)$的简单随机样本，其中$\sigma(\sigma>0)$是未知参数.若$\hat{\sigma}=a\left| X_{1}-X_{2}\right|$为$\sigma$的无偏估计，则 a=（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由于$X_{1}, X_{2}$为来自总体$N(\mu ,\sigma^{2})$的简单随机样本，故$X_{1}, X_{2}$相互独立.

令$Z = X_{1} - X_{2}$，则$Z\sim N(0,2\sigma^{2})$，从而Z的概率密度$f(z) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\cdot \sqrt{2}\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z^{2}}{4\sigma^{2}}}$.$\begin{aligned} E (\mid Z \mid) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | z | f (z) \mathrm {d} z = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \sqrt {2} \sigma} \cdot z \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} z = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi} \sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} \left(z ^ {2}\right) \\ &= \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi} \sigma} \cdot \left(- 4 \sigma^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {2}{\sqrt {\pi}} \sigma . \end{aligned}$由此可得$E (\hat {\sigma}) = E \left(a \mid X _ {1} - X _ {2} \mid\right) = E \left(a \mid Z \mid\right) = \frac {2 a}{\sqrt {\pi}} \sigma .$又因为$\hat{\sigma}$为$\sigma$的无偏估计，所以$E(\hat{\sigma})=\sigma$，即$\frac{2a}{\sqrt{\pi}}\sigma=\sigma$，解得 a$=\frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}.$因此，应选A.

设总体 X服从$[0,\theta]$上的均匀分布，其中$\theta\in(0,+\infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本.记$X_{(n)}=\max\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\}, T_{c}=cX_{(n)}$.

I. 求 c，使得$T_{c}$是$\theta$的无偏估计；

II. 记$h(c)=E\left[ (T_{c}-\theta)^{2} \right]$，求 c使得 h(c)最小.
answerRich:
(1) 当$c=\frac{n+1}{n}$时，$T_{c}$是$\theta$的无偏估计.

(2) 当$c=\frac{n+2}{n+1}$时，h（c）最小.
analysisRich:
（I）由于$X$服从$[0,\theta]$上的均匀分布，故$X$的分布函数为$F _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & x < 0, \\ \frac {x}{\theta}, & 0 \leqslant x < \theta , \\ 1, & x \geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$记随机变量$Y = X_{(n)} = \max \left\{X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}\right\}$. 计算$Y$的分布函数$F_{Y}(y)$.

当$y < 0$时，$F_{Y}(y) = 0.$当$0\leqslant y < \theta$时，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{\max _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} X _ {i} \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant y, X _ {2} \leqslant y, \dots , X _ {n} \leqslant y \right\} \\ \underline {{\text {独立 性}}} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} \dots P \left\{X _ {n} \leqslant y \right\} = F _ {X} ^ {n} (y) = \left(\frac {y}{\theta}\right) ^ {n}. \\ \end{array}$当$y\geqslant \theta$时，$F_{Y}(y) = 1.$于是，$F_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & y < 0,\\ \left(\frac{y}{\theta}\right)^{n}, & 0\leqslant y < \theta ,\\ 1, & y\geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$对$F_{Y}(y)$求导，可得$f _ {Y} (y) = F _ {Y} ^ {\prime} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}}, & 0 < y < \theta , \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$因此，$\begin{aligned} E \left(T _ {c}\right) &= E (c Y) = c \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y \cdot f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = c \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} y \cdot \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}} \mathrm {d} y = c \cdot \frac {n}{\theta^ {n}} \cdot \frac {y ^ {n + 1}}{n + 1} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} \\ &= \frac {c n}{n + 1} \theta . \end{aligned}$若$T_{c}$为$\theta$的无偏估计，则$E\left(T_{c}\right)=\theta$，从而$\frac{cn}{n+1}\theta =\theta$，解得$c=\frac{n+1}{n}.$（Ⅱ）展开 h(c）可得$h (c) = E \left[ \left(T _ {c} - \theta\right) ^ {2} \right] = E \left[ \left(c Y - \theta\right) ^ {2} \right] = c ^ {2} E \left(Y ^ {2}\right) - 2 c \theta E (Y) + \theta^ {2}.$计算$E ( Y^{2})$$E \left(Y ^ {2}\right) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} \cdot f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} y ^ {2} \cdot \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}} \mathrm {d} y = \frac {n}{\theta^ {n}} \cdot \frac {y ^ {n + 2}}{n + 2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} = \frac {n}{n + 2} \theta^ {2}.$于是，$h (c) = c ^ {2} \cdot \frac {n}{n + 2} \theta^ {2} - 2 c \cdot \frac {n}{n + 1} \theta^ {2} + \theta^ {2} = \left(\frac {n}{n + 2} c ^ {2} - \frac {2 n}{n + 1} c + 1\right) \theta^ {2}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[h(c)]}{\mathrm{d}c}=\left(\frac{2n}{n+2} c-\frac{2n}{n+1}\right)\theta^{2}=0$，解得$c=\frac{n+2}{n+1}$该点是h(c)的唯一驻点.又因为$h^{\prime \prime}(c)$$= \frac{2n}{n+2}\theta^{2} > 0$，所以该唯一驻点是h(c)的极小值点，也是最小值点.

因此，当$c=\frac{n+2}{n+1}$时，h(c）最小.

textOptions.A: 如果在检验水平$\alpha=0. 0 5$下拒绝$H_{0}$，那么$\alpha=0. 0 1$下必拒绝$H_{0}$
textOptions.B: 如果在检验水平$\alpha=0. 0 5$下拒绝$H_{0}$，那么$\alpha=0. 0 1$下必接受$H_{0}$
textOptions.C: 如果在检验水平$\alpha=0. 0 5$下接受$H_{0}$，那么$\alpha=0. 0 1$下必拒绝$H_{0}$
textOptions.D: 如果在检验水平$\alpha=0. 0 5$下接受$H_{0}$，那么$\alpha=0. 0 1$下必接受$H_{0}$

analysisRich:
解 由于$\sigma^2$未知，故应采用$t$检验法，检验统计量可取为$Z = \frac{\bar{X} - \mu_0}{S / \sqrt{n}}$（注：$S^{2}$为样本方差，为方差$\sigma^2$的无偏估计量）.$\bar{X} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_{i},\bar{X}\sim N\left(\mu ,\frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}\right)$，故当假设$H_{0}$为真时，$Z\sim t(n - 1)$.

当$\alpha = 0.05$时，拒绝域为$\left|\frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{S / \sqrt{n}}\right| > t_{\frac{\alpha}{2}} = t_{0.025}$，其中$t_{0.025}$为上0.025分位点.$\alpha = 0.05$对应的接受域为$\left(\mu_0 - t_{0.025}\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}},\mu_0 + t_{0.025}\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}}\right)$.

当$\alpha=0.01$时，拒绝域为$\left| \frac{\overline{{x}}-\mu_{0}}{S / \sqrt{n}} \right| > t_{\frac{\alpha}{2}}=t_{0.005}$，其中$t_{0.005}$为上0.005分位点.$\alpha=0.01$对应的接受域为$\left(\mu_{0}-t_{0.005}\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}},\mu_{0}+t_{0.005}\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}}\right).$因为$t_{0.025}<t_{0.005}$，所以$\alpha=0.05$对应的接受域包含于$\alpha=0.01$对应的接受域.若当检验水平$\alpha=0.05$时，接受$H_{0}$，则当检验水平$\alpha=0.01$时，必接受$H_{0}.$因此，应选D.

questionText: 设$X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots , X_{1 6}$是来自总体$N (\mu , 4)$的简单随机样本，考虑假设检验问题：$H_{0}:\mu \leqslant 1 0, H_{1}:\mu > 1 0, \Phi (x)$表示标准正态分布函数，若该检验问题的拒绝域为$W=\{\bar{X}>1 1 \}$，其中$\bar{X}=\frac{1}{1 6} \sum_{i=1}^{1 6} X_{i}$，则$\mu =1 1. 5$时，该检验犯第二类错误的概率为（    ）
analysisRich: 解 根据已知条件，$\mu=1 1. 5$，原假设$H_{0}:\mu\leqslant1 0$不为真.由于该检验问题的拒绝域为$W=\left\{\overline{X}>11\right\}$，故当$\overline{X}\leqslant1 1$时，不拒绝$H_{0}$.此时，该检验犯了第二类错误，其概率为$P\{\overline{X}\leqslant11\}$下面我们计算$P\{\overline{X}\leqslant11\}$由已知条件可得$n=1 6$，故$\overline{X}\sim N\left(\mu ,\frac{4}{1 6}\right)$，即$\overline{X}\sim N\left(1 1. 5 , \frac{1}{4}\right)$.标准化可得，$\frac{\overline{X}-1 1. 5}{\frac{1}{2}}\sim N(0,1).$$P\{\overline{X}\leqslant11\}=P\left\{\frac{\overline{X}-1 1. 5}{\frac{1}{2}}\leqslant\frac{1 1-1 1. 5}{\frac{1}{2}}\right\}=\Phi(-1)=1-\Phi(1).$因此，应选B.

questionText:
设总体$X$的概率密度为$f (x; \sigma) = \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}}, (- \infty < x < + \infty).$其中$\sigma \in(0,+\infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本.记$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat{\sigma}.$I. 求$\hat{\sigma}$;

II. 求$E(\hat{\sigma}),D(\hat{\sigma}).$
answerRich: （I）$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat{\sigma}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \mid X_{i}\mid}{n}；$（Ⅱ）$E(\hat{\sigma})=\sigma$，$D(\hat{\sigma})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}.$
analysisRich: 解（ I ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots , x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$的一组样本值.似然函数为$L (\sigma) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \sigma\right) = \frac {1}{2 ^ {n} \sigma^ {n}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left| x _ {1} \right| + \left| x _ {2} \right| + \cdots + \left| x _ {n} \right|}{\sigma}}, - \infty < x _ {i} < + \infty , i = 1, 2, \dots , n.$对 L（$\sigma$）取对数，得$\ln L (\sigma) = - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| x _ {i} \right|}{\sigma} - n \ln (2 \sigma).$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\sigma)]}{\mathrm{d}\sigma}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \mid x_{i}\mid}{\sigma^{2}}-\frac{n}{\sigma}=0$即$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \mid x_{i}\mid-n\sigma=0$解得$\sigma=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \mid x_{i}\mid}{n}.$因此，$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\sigma} = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}.$（Ⅱ）由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$为来自总体X的简单随机样本，故它们相互独立，且与总体X同分布$E(X_{i})=E(X), E(|X_{i}|)=E(|X|), i=1,2,\dots ,n.$根据期望的线性性质，$E (\hat {\sigma}) = E \left(\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}\right) = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E \left(\left| X _ {i} \right|\right)}{n} = \frac {n E \left(\left| X \right|\right)}{n} = E (\left| X \right|).$根据期望的定义，$\begin{aligned} E (\mid X \mid) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot f (x; \sigma) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{\sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}}\right) = - \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = - \sigma \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \sigma . \end{aligned}$因此，$E(\hat{\sigma}) = \sigma .$下面计算$D(\hat{\sigma})。$由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$相互独立，且与总体$X$同分布，故$D(\mid X_{i}\mid) = D(\mid X\mid)$，$i = 1, 2, \dots, n.$$D (\hat {\sigma}) = D \left(\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} D \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \cdot n D (\mid X \mid) = \frac {D (\mid X \mid)}{n}.$根据方差的计算公式，$D (\mid X \mid) = E \left(\mid X \mid^ {2}\right) - \left[ E (\mid X \mid) \right] ^ {2} = E \left(X ^ {2}\right) - \left[ E (\mid X \mid) \right] ^ {2}.$$\begin{aligned} E \left(X ^ {2}\right) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot f (x; \sigma) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{\sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}}\right) = - \left(x ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \cdot x \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \stackrel {*} {=} 2 \sigma^ {2}. \end{aligned}$于是，$D ( \mid X \mid ) = 2 \sigma^{2} - \sigma^{2} = \sigma^{2}.$因此，$D(\hat{\sigma}) = \frac{D(|X|)}{n} = \frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}.$

answerRich: ( I )$A=\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}};$( II )$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量为$\widehat{\sigma^{2}}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(X_{i}-\mu\right)^{2}}{n}.$
analysisRich: 解（ I ）利用$\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f ( x ; \sigma^{2} ) \mathrm{d} x=1$来计算 A.$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x; \sigma^ {2}) \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {\mu} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {A}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \underline {{= t = x - \mu}} A \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} t = A \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \cdot \left(\frac {t}{\sigma}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {t}{\sigma}\right) \\ \frac {\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = 1}{\underline {{}}} A \cdot \frac {\sqrt {2 \pi}}{2} &= 1. \end{aligned}$因此，$A=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2\pi}}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}.$（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一组样本值，则关于$\sigma^2$的似然函数为$\begin{array}{l} L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \sigma^ {2}\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac {1}{\sigma} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & x _ {1} \geqslant \mu , x _ {2} \geqslant \mu , \dots , x _ {n} \geqslant \mu , \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} \right. \\ = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(\frac {2}{\pi}\right) ^ {\frac {n}{2}} \cdot \left(\frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}}\right) ^ {\frac {n}{2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & x _ {1} \geqslant \mu , x _ {2} \geqslant \mu , \dots , x _ {n} \geqslant \mu , \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \\ \end{array}$当$x_{1}\geqslant \mu ,x_{2}\geqslant \mu ,\dots ,x_{n}\geqslant \mu$时，$\ln L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \frac {n}{2} \ln \frac {2}{\pi} - \frac {n}{2} \ln \sigma^ {2} - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\sigma^{2})\right]}{\mathrm{d}(\sigma^{2})}=0$即$-\frac{n}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{\sigma^{2}}+\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i}-\mu\right)^{2}}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{\sigma^{4}}=0$，解得$\sigma^{2}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i}-\mu\right)^{2}}{n}.$因此，$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\sigma^ {2}} = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(X _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{n}.$

questionText:
设某元件的使用寿命$T$的分布函数为$F (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}, & t \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}, \end{array} \right.$其中$\theta, m$为参数且均大于零.

I. 求概率$P\{T > t\}$与$P\{T > s + t \mid T > s\}$，其中$s > 0, t > 0$；

II. 任取 n个这种元件做寿命试验，测得它们的寿命分别为$t_{1}, t_{2}, \dots , t_{n}$，若 m已知，求$\theta$的最大似然估计值$\hat{\theta}.$
answerRich: （I）$P \left\{ T > t \right\} = \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\frac{t}{\theta}\right)^{m}}, P \left\{ T > s + t \mid T > s \right\} = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{s^{m}-(s+t)^{m}}{\theta^{m}}};$（Ⅱ）$\theta$的最大似然估计值为$\hat{\theta}=\sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}.$
analysisRich: （I）由分布函数的定义以及 s > 0，t > 0可得，$P \left\{T > t \right\} = 1 - P \left\{T \leqslant t \right\} = 1 - F (t) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}.$$P \left\{T > s + t \mid T > s \right\} = \frac {P \left\{T > s + t \right\}}{P \left\{T > s \right\}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {s + t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}}{\mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {s}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {s ^ {m} - (s + t) ^ {m}}{\theta^ {m}}}.$（Ⅱ）计算概率密度$f(t; \theta).$$f (t; \theta) = F ^ {\prime} (t; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}} \cdot (- m) \cdot \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m - 1} \cdot \frac {1}{\theta}, & t > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {m t ^ {m - 1}}{\theta^ {m}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}, & t > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \end{array} \right.$似然函数$L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(t _ {i}; \theta\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(t _ {1} t _ {2} \dots t _ {n}\right) ^ {m - 1} \cdot \left(\frac {m}{\theta^ {m}}\right) ^ {n} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\theta^ {m}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} t _ {i} ^ {m}}, & t _ {i} > 0, i = 1, 2, \dots , n, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$取对数得$\ln L (\theta) = (m - 1) \ln \left(t _ {1} t _ {2} \dots t _ {n}\right) + n \left(\ln m - m \ln \theta\right) - \frac {1}{\theta^ {m}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} t _ {i} ^ {m}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\theta)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=-\frac{mn}{\theta}+\frac{m}{\theta^{m+1}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}=0$，可得$mn\theta^{m}=m\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}$. 从而$\theta^{m}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m},$$\hat{\theta}=\sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}.$因此，$\theta$的最大似然估计值为$\hat{\theta}=\sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}.$

questionText: 设总体 X的概率分布为$P\{X=1\}=\frac{1-\theta}{2}, P\{X=2\}=P\{X=3\}=\frac{1+\theta}{4}$，利用来自总体的样本值1,3,2,2,1,3,1,2可得$\theta$的最大似然估计值为（    ）
analysisRich: 解记$P \{ X=i \}=p_{i}, i=1,2,3.$由于样本值中1出现3次，2出现3次，3出现2次，故似然函数$L (\theta) = p _ {1} ^ {3} p _ {2} ^ {3} p _ {3} ^ {2} = \left(\frac {1 - \theta}{2}\right) ^ {3} \left(\frac {1 + \theta}{4}\right) ^ {5} = \frac {1}{2 ^ {1 3}} (1 - \theta) ^ {3} (1 + \theta) ^ {5}.$计算$\ln L(\theta)$得，$\ln L (\theta) = - 1 3 \ln 2 + 3 \ln (1 - \theta) + 5 \ln (1 + \theta).$计算$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\theta)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\theta}$得，$\frac {\mathrm {d} [ \ln L (\theta) ]}{\mathrm {d} \theta} = \frac {- 3}{1 - \theta} + \frac {5}{1 + \theta}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\theta)]}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=0$，可得$\frac{5}{1+\theta}=\frac{3}{1-\theta}$，即$5(1-\theta)=3(1+\theta).$，解得$\theta=\frac{1}{4}.$因此，应选A.

questionText:
假设某种元件的寿命服从指数分布，其均值 $\theta$ 是未知参数。为估计 $\theta$，取 $n$ 个这种元件同时做寿命试验，试验到出现 $k$ 个元件失效时停止。

（1）若 $k=1$，失效元件的寿命记为 $T$：①计算 $T$ 的概率密度；②记 $\hat\theta=aT$，确定 $a$ 使得 $\hat\theta$ 是 $\theta$ 的无偏估计量，并求 $D(\hat\theta)$。

（2）已知 $k$ 个失效元件的寿命值分别为 $0\le t_1\le t_2\le\cdots\le t_k$，似然函数 $L(\theta)=\frac1{\theta^k}e^{-\frac1\theta[\sum_{i=1}^kt_i+(n-k)t_k]}$，求 $\theta$ 的最大似然估计值。

answerRich: (23) (I)$\lambda$的矩估计量为$\hat{\lambda} = \frac{2}{\bar{X}}$; (II)$\lambda$的最大似然估计量为$\hat{\lambda} = \frac{2}{\bar{X}}$.
analysisRich: （I）由题设知，$\begin{aligned} E (X) &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \lambda^ {2} x ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \lambda x} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = \lambda x} \frac {1}{\lambda} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \frac {1}{\lambda} \left(- \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cdot t ^ {2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t\right) = \frac {2}{\lambda} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \frac {2}{\lambda} \left(- \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cdot t \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t\right) = \frac {2}{\lambda}. \end{aligned}$于是$\lambda = \frac{2}{E(X)}$，用$\overline{X} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} X_{i}$代替$E(X)$，得到参数$\lambda$的矩估计量为$\hat {\lambda} = \frac {2}{\bar {X}}.$（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一个样本值，则似然函数为$L (\lambda)=L \left(x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}; \lambda\right)=\prod_{i=1}^{n} f \left(x_{i}; \lambda\right)=\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \lambda^{2 n} x_{1} x_{2} \dots x_{n} \mathrm{e}^{- \lambda \left(x_{1}+x_{2}+\dots+x_{n}\right)}, & x_{1}>0, x_{2}>0, \dots, x_{n}>0, \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$当$x_{1}>0, x_{2}>0, \dots, x_{n}>0$时，$\ln L (\lambda)=\ln \left(x_{1} x_{2} \dots x_{n}\right)+2 n \ln \lambda-\lambda \left(x_{1}+x_{2}+\dots+x_{n}\right).$$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\lambda)]}{\mathrm{d}\lambda}=0$即$\frac{2 n}{\lambda}-\left(x_{1}+x_{2}+\dots+x_{n}\right)=0$解得$\lambda=\frac{2 n}{x_{1}+x_{2}+\dots+x_{n}}.$于是参数$\lambda$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\lambda} = \frac {2 n}{X _ {1} + X _ {2} + \cdots + X _ {n}} = \frac {2 n}{n \bar {X}} = \frac {2}{\bar {X}}.$

questionText:
设$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$为来自正态总体$N\left(\mu_{0},\sigma^{2}\right)$的简单随机样本，其中$\mu_{0}$已知，$\sigma^{2}>0$未知，$\bar{X}$和$S^{2}$分别表示样本均值和样本方差.

I. 求参数$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计$\hat{\sigma}^{2}$；

II. 计算$E(\hat{\sigma}^{2})$和$D(\hat{\sigma}^{2})$
answerRich: (23) (I)$\hat{\sigma}^{2} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(X_{i} - \mu_{0}\right)^{2}$;$(\mathrm {I I}) E \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \sigma^ {2}, D \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {2 \sigma^ {4}}{n}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）设 X为正态总体，$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots , x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$的一个样本值.由$X\sim N(\mu_{0},\sigma^{2})$知，X的概率密度为$f \left(x; \mu_ {0}, \sigma^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left(x - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}},$从而似然函数为$L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left(x _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} = \left(2 \pi\right) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}},$两边取对数得$\ln L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = - \frac {n}{2} \ln 2 \pi - \frac {n}{2} \ln \sigma^ {2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L\left(\sigma^{2}\right)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\left(\sigma^{2}\right)} = 0$，即有$-\frac{n}{2\sigma^2} +\frac{1}{2\left(\sigma^2\right)^2}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i} - \mu_{0}\right)^{2} = 0$（注意这里是关于$\sigma^2$求导），解得$\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i} - \mu_{0}\right)^{2}$.于是参数$\sigma^2$的最大似然估计为$\widehat {\sigma^ {2}} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(X _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由于$X_{i}\sim N(\mu_{0},\sigma^{2})$，故$\frac{X_{i} - \mu_{0}}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1),i = 1,2,\dots,n$，从而由（I）知，$\frac {n \widehat {\sigma^ {2}}}{\sigma^ {2}} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\left(X _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \sim \chi^ {2} (n).$于是$E\left(\frac{n\widehat{\sigma}^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}\right)=n,D\left(\frac{n\widehat{\sigma}^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}\right)=2n$，即有$E \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \sigma^ {2}, \quad D \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {2 \sigma^ {4}}{n}.$（法二）由（I）知，$E \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E \left[ \left(X _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2} \right] = E \left[ \left(X - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2} \right] \xlongequal {\text {方 差 的 定 义}} D (X) = \sigma^ {2}.$由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$相互独立，故$(X_{1} - \mu_{0})^{2}, (X_{2} - \mu_{0})^{2}, \dots, (X_{n} - \mu_{0})^{2}$相互独立，从而$D \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} D \left[ \left(X _ {i} - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2} \right] = \frac {1}{n} D \left[ \left(X - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2} \right].$又$X\sim N(\mu_{0},\sigma^{2})$，故$\frac{X-\mu_{0}}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1)$，从而$\frac{(X-\mu_{0})^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}\sim \chi^{2}(1),D\left[ \frac{(X-\mu_{0})^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}\right] = 2.$于是$D \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {1}{n} D \left[ \left(X - \mu_ {0}\right) ^ {2} \right] = \frac {1}{n} \cdot 2 \sigma^ {4} = \frac {2 \sigma^ {4}}{n}.$综上所述，$E(\widehat{\sigma^{2}}) = \sigma^{2}, D(\widehat{\sigma^{2}}) = \frac{2\sigma^{4}}{n}.$

questionText:
设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立且分别服从正态分布$N\left(\mu,\sigma^{2}\right)$与$N\left(\mu,2\sigma^{2}\right)$，其中$\sigma$是未知参数且$\sigma >0$记$Z=X-Y.$I. 求 Z的概率密度$f\left(z;\sigma^{2}\right)$；

II. 设$Z_{1},Z_{2},\cdots,Z_{n}$为来自总体 Z的简单随机样本，求$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量$\hat{\sigma}^{2}$；

III. 证明$\hat{\sigma}^{2}$为$\sigma^{2}$的无偏估计量.
answerRich: (23) ( I )$f ( z ; \sigma^{2} )=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6 \pi} \sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z^{2}}{6 \sigma^{2}}},-\infty<z<+\infty;$（Ⅱ）$\widehat{\sigma^{2}}=\frac{1}{3n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}Z_{i}^{2};$（Ⅲ）证明略.
analysisRich: （I）由于相互独立且服从正态分布的随机变量的线性组合仍服从正态分布，且$E (Z) = E (X) - E (Y) = \mu - \mu = 0,$$D (Z) = D (X - Y) = D (X) + D (Y) = \sigma^ {2} + 2 \sigma^ {2} = 3 \sigma^ {2},$故$Z\sim N(0,3\sigma^{2})$，从而Z的概率密度$f \left(z; \sigma^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sqrt {3 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \cdot 3 \sigma^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {6 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{6 \sigma^ {2}}}, - \infty < z < + \infty .$（Ⅱ）设$z_{1}, z_{2}, \dots, z_{n}$是来自于样本$Z_{1}, Z_{2}, \dots, Z_{n}$的一个样本值，则似然函数为$L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(z _ {i}; \sigma^ {2}\right) = (6 \pi) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \cdot \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + z _ {n} ^ {2}}{6 \sigma^ {2}}}.$取对数得$\ln L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = - \frac {n}{2} \ln (6 \pi) - \frac {n}{2} \ln \sigma^ {2} - \frac {z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + z _ {n} ^ {2}}{6 \sigma^ {2}}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\sigma^{2})\right]}{\mathrm{d}(\sigma^{2})}=0$即有$-\frac{n}{2\sigma^{2}}+\frac{z_{1}^{2}+z_{2}^{2}+\cdots+z_{n}^{2}}{6(\sigma^{2})^{2}}=0$解得$\sigma^{2}=\frac{z_{1}^{2}+z_{2}^{2}+\cdots+z_{n}^{2}}{3n}.$于是$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量为$\widehat {\sigma^ {2}} = \frac {Z _ {1} ^ {2} + Z _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + Z _ {n} ^ {2}}{3 n} = \frac {1}{3 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Z _ {i} ^ {2}.$（Ⅲ）由于$E \left(\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}\right) = E \left(\frac {1}{3 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Z _ {i} ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{3} E \left(Z ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{3} \left[ D (Z) + \left(E (Z)\right) ^ {2} \right] = \frac {3 \sigma^ {2}}{3} = \sigma^ {2},$故$\widehat{\sigma^2}$为$\sigma^2$的无偏估计量，结论得证.

解（I）由题设知，$\begin{aligned} E (X) &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {\theta^ {2}}{x ^ {3}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\theta}{x}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\theta^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\theta}{x}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \theta \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\theta}{x}} \mathrm {d} \left(- \frac {\theta}{x}\right) \\ \underline {{\underline {{t}} = - \frac {\theta}{x}}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} \theta \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t &= \theta \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \Big | _ {- \infty} ^ {0} = \theta , \end{aligned}$即$\theta = E(X)$. 以$\overline{X} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} X_{i}$代替$E(X)$, 得到$\theta$的矩估计量$\hat{\theta} = \overline{X}$.

（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一组样本值，则关于$\theta$的似然函数为$L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \theta\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {\theta^ {2 n}}{\left(x _ {1} x _ {2} \cdots x _ {n}\right) ^ {3}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \theta \left(\frac {1}{x _ {1}} + \frac {1}{x _ {2}} + \cdots + \frac {1}{x _ {n}}\right)}, & x _ {1} > 0, x _ {2} > 0, \dots , x _ {n} > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$当$x_{1} > 0,x_{2} > 0,\dots ,x_{n} > 0$时，$\ln L (\theta) = 2 n \ln \theta - 3 \ln \left(x _ {1} x _ {2} \dots x _ {n}\right) - \theta \left(\frac {1}{x _ {1}} + \frac {1}{x _ {2}} + \dots + \frac {1}{x _ {n}}\right).$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\theta)]}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = 0$，即$\frac{2n}{\theta} - \left(\frac{1}{x_1} + \frac{1}{x_2} + \dots + \frac{1}{x_n}\right) = 0$，解得$\theta = \frac{2n}{\frac{1}{x_1} + \frac{1}{x_2} + \dots + \frac{1}{x_n}}.$因此，$\theta$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\theta} = \frac {2 n}{\frac {1}{X _ {1}} + \frac {1}{X _ {2}} + \cdots + \frac {1}{X _ {n}}} = \frac {2 n}{\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{X _ {i}}}.$

analysisRich: （ I ）由于$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x; \theta) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {\theta} ^ {1} \frac {x}{1 - \theta} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1 + \theta}{2},$故$\theta = 2 E ( X ) - 1.$用样本均值$\overline{X}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}$代替$E ( X )$，可得$\theta$的矩估计量$\hat {\theta} = 2 \bar {X} - 1.$（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一组样本值，则似然函数为$L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \theta\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{(1 - \theta) ^ {n}}, & \theta \leqslant x _ {1}, x _ {2}, \dots , x _ {n} \leqslant 1, \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{(1 - \theta) ^ {n}}, & \theta \leqslant \min _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} x _ {i}, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \right.$又由于$\frac{1}{(1-\theta)^{n}}$是关于$\theta$的单调增加函数，故当$\theta=\min_{1\leqslant i\leqslant n}x_{i}$时，$L(\theta)$取值最大因此，$\theta$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\theta} = \min _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} X _ {i}.$

questionText:
某工程师为了解一台天平的精度，用该天平对一物体的质量做 n次测量，该物体的质量$\mu$是已知的.设 n次测量结果$X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$相互独立且均服从正态分布$N\left(\mu ,\sigma^{2}\right)$，该工程师记录的是 n次测量的绝对误差$Z_{i}=\left|X_{i}-\mu\right|(i=1,2,\cdots,n).$利用$Z_{1},Z_{2},\cdots,Z_{n}$估计$\sigma.$I. 求$Z_{1}$的概率密度；

II. 利用一阶矩求$\sigma$的矩估计量；

III. 求$\sigma$的最大似然估计量.
answerRich:
( I )$f_{Z_{1}}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \frac{1}{\sigma} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}}, & z \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & z < 0; \end{array} \right.$( II )$\hat{\sigma} = \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}} \bar{Z}$;

( III )$\hat{\sigma} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} Z_{i}^{2}}$.
analysisRich:
解（I）由题设知，$X_{1}\sim N(\mu ,\sigma^{2})$，从而$\frac{X_{1}-\mu}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1).$当 z < 0时，$F_{Z_{1}}(z)=0.$当$z\geqslant 0$时，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z _ {1}} (z) = P \left\{Z _ {1} \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{\left| X _ {1} - \mu \right| \leqslant z \right\} \\ = P \left\{\left| \frac {X _ {1} - \mu}{\sigma} \right| \leqslant \frac {z}{\sigma} \right\} = P \left\{- \frac {z}{\sigma} \leqslant \frac {X _ {1} - \mu}{\sigma} \leqslant \frac {z}{\sigma} \right\} \\ = 2 \Phi \left(\frac {z}{\sigma}\right) - 1, \\ \end{array}$其中$\varPhi(x)$为标准正态分布函数.

于是，$Z_{1}$的分布函数为$F_{Z_{1}}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 2\Phi \left(\frac{z}{\sigma}\right) - 1, & z\geqslant 0, \\ 0, & z < 0. \end{array} \right.$因此，$Z_{1}$的概率密度为$f _ {Z _ {1}} (z) = F _ {Z _ {1}} ^ {\prime} (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{\sigma} \varphi \left(\frac {z}{\sigma}\right), & z \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & z < 0 \end{array} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & z \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & z < 0, \end{array} \right. \right.$其中$\varphi (x)$为标准正态分布的概率密度.

（Ⅱ）由于$\begin{aligned} E \left(Z _ {1}\right) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} z f _ {Z _ {1}} (z) \mathrm {d} z = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} z \cdot \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} z = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}\right) \\ &= - \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma , \end{aligned}$故$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}} E\left(Z_{1}\right)$. 用$\overline{Z} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} Z_{i}$代替$E\left(Z_{1}\right)$，得到$\sigma$的矩估计量$\hat {\sigma} = \sqrt {\frac {\pi}{2}} \bar {Z}.$（Ⅲ）设$z_{1}, z_{2}, \dots, z_{n}$是相应于$Z_{1}, Z_{2}, \dots, Z_{n}$的一组样本值，则似然函数为$L (\sigma) = L \left(z _ {1}, z _ {2}, \dots , z _ {n}; \sigma\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f _ {Z _ {i}} \left(z _ {i}\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(\frac {2}{\pi}\right) ^ {\frac {n}{2}} \frac {1}{\sigma^ {n}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \left(z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \dots + z _ {n} ^ {2}\right)}, & z _ {1} > 0, z _ {2} > 0, \dots , z _ {n} > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$当$z_{1} > 0, z_{2} > 0, \dots, z_{n} > 0$时，$\ln L (\sigma) = \frac {n}{2} \ln \frac {2}{\pi} - n \ln \sigma - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \left(z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \dots + z _ {n} ^ {2}\right).$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\sigma)]}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = 0$，即$-\frac{n}{\sigma} +\frac{1}{\sigma^3}\left(z_1^2 +z_2^2 +\dots +z_n^2\right) = 0$，解得$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}z_i^2}$.

因此，$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\sigma} = \sqrt {\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Z _ {i} ^ {2}}.$

questionText:
设总体$X$的概率密度为$f (x; \sigma) = \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}}, - \infty < x < + \infty$$\sigma \in (0, + \infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$为来自总体$X$的简单随机样本.记$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat{\sigma}$.

I. 求$\hat{\sigma}$；

II. 求$E(\hat{\sigma})$和$D(\hat{\sigma})$
answerRich: （I）$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat{\sigma}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \mid X_{i}\mid}{n}；$（Ⅱ）$E(\hat{\sigma})=\sigma,D(\hat{\sigma})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一组样本值. 似然函数为$L (\sigma) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \sigma\right) = \frac {1}{2 ^ {n} \sigma^ {n}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left| x _ {1} \right| + \left| x _ {2} \right| + \cdots + \left| x _ {n} \right|}{\sigma}}, - \infty < x _ {i} < + \infty , i = 1, 2, \dots , n.$对 L （$\sigma$）取对数，得$\ln L (\sigma) = - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| x _ {i} \right|}{\sigma} - n \ln (2 \sigma).$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\sigma)]}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}|x_i|}{\sigma^2} - \frac{n}{\sigma} = 0$，即$\sum_{i=1}^{n}|x_i| - n\sigma = 0.$解得$\sigma = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}|x_i|}{n}.$因此，$\sigma$的最大似然估计量为$\hat {\sigma} = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}.$（Ⅱ）由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$为来自总体X的简单随机样本，故它们相互独立，且与总体X同分布$E \left( X_{i}\right) = E \left( X\right), E \left( \mid X_{i} \mid\right) = E \left( \mid X \mid\right), i = 1, 2, \dots , n.$根据期望的线性性质，$E \left(\hat {\sigma}\right) = E \left(\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}\right) = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E \left(\left| X _ {i} \right|\right)}{n} = \frac {n E \left(\left| X \right|\right)}{n} = E \left(\left| X \right|\right).$根据期望的定义，$\begin{aligned} E (\mid X \mid) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot f (x; \sigma) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{\sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}}\right) = - \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = - \sigma \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \sigma . \end{aligned}$因此，$E(\hat{\sigma}) = \sigma.$下面计算$D(\hat{\sigma})$由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$相互独立，且与总体$X$同分布，故$D(\mid X_{i}\mid) = D(\mid X\mid)$，$i = 1, 2, \dots, n.$$D (\hat {\sigma}) = D \left(\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|}{n}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} D \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left| X _ {i} \right|\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \cdot n D (\left| X \right|) = \frac {D (\left| X \right|)}{n}.$根据方差的计算公式，$D (| X |) = E \left(| X | ^ {2}\right) - \left[ E \left(| X |\right) \right] ^ {2} = E \left(X ^ {2}\right) - \left[ E \left(| X |\right) \right] ^ {2}.$$\begin{aligned} E \left(X ^ {2}\right) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot f (x; \sigma) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{\sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}}\right) = - \left(x ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \cdot x \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm {d} x \stackrel {*} {=} 2 \sigma^ {2}. \end{aligned}$于是，$D ( \mid X \mid ) = 2 \sigma^{2} - \sigma^{2} = \sigma^{2}.$因此，$D(\hat{\sigma}) = \frac{D(|X|)}{n} = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}.$

questionText:
设总体$X$的概率密度为$f \left(x; \sigma^ {2}\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {A}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & x \geqslant \mu \\ 0, & x < \mu \end{array} \right.$其中$\mu$是已知参数，$\sigma > 0$是未知参数，$A$是常数.$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$是来自总体$X$的简单随机样本.

I. 求 A；

II. 求$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量.
answerRich: （ I ）$A=\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}};$（ II ）$\sigma^{2}$的最大似然估计量为$\widehat{\sigma^{2}}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(X_{i}-\mu\right)^{2}}{n}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）利用$\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f ( x ; \sigma^{2} ) \mathrm{d} x=1$来计算A.$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x; \sigma^ {2}) \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {\mu} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {A}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \underline {{= t = x - \mu}} A \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} t = A \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \cdot \left(\frac {t}{\sigma}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {t}{\sigma}\right) \\ \frac {\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = 1}{\underline {{}}} A \cdot \frac {\sqrt {2 \pi}}{2} &= 1. \end{aligned}$因此，$A = \frac{2}{\sqrt{2\pi}} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}.$（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots , x_{n}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$的一组样本值，则关于$\sigma^2$的似然函数为$\begin{array}{l} L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \sigma^ {2}\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac {1}{\sigma} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & x _ {1} \geqslant \mu , x _ {2} \geqslant \mu , \dots , x _ {n} \geqslant \mu , \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} \right. \\ = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(\frac {2}{\pi}\right) ^ {\frac {n}{2}} \cdot \left(\frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}}\right) ^ {\frac {n}{2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, & x _ {1} \geqslant \mu , x _ {2} \geqslant \mu , \dots , x _ {n} \geqslant \mu , \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \\ \end{array}$当$x_{1}\geqslant \mu ,x_{2}\geqslant \mu ,\dots ,x_{n}\geqslant \mu$时，$\ln L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \frac {n}{2} \ln \frac {2}{\pi} - \frac {n}{2} \ln \sigma^ {2} - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(x _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L\left(\sigma^2\right)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\left(\sigma^2\right)} = 0$，即$-\frac{n}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{\sigma^2} +\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i} - \mu\right)^{2}}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{\sigma^{4}} = 0$，解得$\sigma^2 = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{i} - \mu\right)^{2}}{n}$因此，$\sigma^2$的最大似然估计量为$\widehat {\sigma^ {2}} = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(X _ {i} - \mu\right) ^ {2}}{n}.$

questionText:
设某元件的使用寿命$T$的分布函数为$F (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}, & t \geqslant 0 \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} \right.$其中$\theta, m$为参数且大于零.

I. 求概率$P\{T > t\}$与$P\{T > s + t \mid T > s\}$，其中$s > 0, t > 0$.

II. 任取 n个这种元件做寿命试验，测得它们的寿命分别为$t_{1}, t_{2}, \dots , t_{n}$，若 m已知，求$\theta$的最大似然估计值$\hat{\theta}.$
answerRich: （I）$P \left\{ T > t \right\} = \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\frac{t}{\theta}\right)^{m}}, P \left\{ T > s + t \mid T > s \right\} = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{s^{m} - (s + t)^{m}}{\theta^{m}}};$（Ⅱ）$\theta$的最大似然估计值为$\hat{\theta}=\sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}.$
analysisRich: （I）由分布函数的定义以及$s > 0,t > 0$可得，$P \left\{T > t \right\} = 1 - P \left\{T \leqslant t \right\} = 1 - F (t) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {n}}.$$P \left\{T > s + t \mid T > s \right\} = \frac {P \left\{T > s + t \right\}}{P \left\{T > s \right\}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {s + t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}}{\mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {s}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {s ^ {m} - \left(s + t\right) ^ {m}}{\theta^ {m}}}.$（Ⅱ）计算概率密度$f ( t ; \theta)$$f (t; \theta) = F ^ {\prime} (t; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}} \cdot (- m) \cdot \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m - 1} \cdot \frac {1}{\theta}, & t > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {m t ^ {m - 1}}{\theta^ {m}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {t}{\theta}\right) ^ {m}}, & t > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \right.$似然函数$L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(t _ {i}; \theta\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(t _ {1} t _ {2} \dots t _ {n}\right) ^ {m - 1} \cdot \left(\frac {m}{\theta^ {m}}\right) ^ {n} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\theta^ {m}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} t _ {i} ^ {m}}, & t _ {i} > 0, i = 1, 2, \dots , n, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$取对数得$\ln L (\theta) = (m - 1) \ln \left(t _ {1} t _ {2} \dots t _ {n}\right) + n \left(\ln m - m \ln \theta\right) - \frac {1}{\theta^ {m}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} t _ {i} ^ {m}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[\ln L(\theta)]}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = -\frac{mn}{\theta} + \frac{m}{\theta^{m + 1}}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}t_{i}^{m} = 0$，可得$mn\theta^{m} = m\sum_{i = 1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}$. 从而$\theta^{m} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}t_{i}^{m},\hat{\theta} = \sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}$因此，$\theta$的最大似然估计值为$\hat{\theta} = \sqrt[m]{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}t_{i}^{m}}$

questionText: 设$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$为来自均值为$\theta$的指数分布总体的简单随机样本，$Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \dots, Y_{m}$为来自均值为2$\theta$的指数分布总体的简单随机样本，且两样本相互独立，其中$\theta(\theta>0)$是未知参数。利用样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}, Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \dots, Y_{m}$求$\theta$的最大似然估计量$\hat{\theta}$，并求$D(\hat{\theta})$
answerRich: $\hat {\theta} = \frac {2 \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} + \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {m} Y _ {j}}{2 (m + n)}, D (\hat {\theta}) = \frac {\theta^ {2}}{m + n}.$
analysisRich: 解$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$是来自总体 X的简单随机样本.由于$E ( X )=\theta$，故 X服从参数为$\frac{1}{\theta}$的指数分布.于是，X的概率密度函数为$f _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\theta}}, & x > 0, \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$$Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \dots , Y_{m}$是来自总体Y的简单随机样本.由于$E(Y)=2\theta$，故Y服从参数为$\frac{1}{2\theta}$的指数分布.于是，Y的概率密度函数为$f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 \theta} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {y}{2 \theta}}, & y > 0, \\ 0, & y \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots , x_{n}, y_{1}, y_{2}, \dots , y_{m}$是相应于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}, Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \dots , Y_{m}$的一组样本值，则似然函数$L (\theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 ^ {m} \theta^ {m + n}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i}}{\theta}} - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} y _ {j}}{2 \theta}, & x _ {i} > 0, y _ {j} > 0, i = 1, 2, \dots , n, j = 1, 2, \dots , m, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$当$x_{i} > 0, y_{j} > 0, i = 1, 2, \dots , n, j = 1, 2, \dots , m$时，取对数得$\ln L (\theta) = - m \ln 2 - (m + n) \ln \theta - \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i}}{\theta} - \frac {\sum_ {j = 1} ^ {m} y _ {j}}{2 \theta}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\theta)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=0$即$-\frac{m+n}{\theta}+\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}}{\theta^{2}}+\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{m}y_{j}}{2\theta^{2}}=0$解得$\theta=\frac{2\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}+\sum_{j=1}^{m}y_{j}}{2(m+n)}$因此，$\theta$的最大似然估计量$\hat{\theta}=\frac{2\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}+\sum_{j=1}^{m}Y_{j}}{2(m+n)}$下面计算$D(\hat{\theta})$$\begin{aligned} D (\hat {\theta}) &= D \left[ \frac {2 \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} + \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {m} Y _ {j}}{2 (m + n)} \right] = \frac {1}{(m + n) ^ {2}} D \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}\right) + \frac {1}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} D \left(\sum_ {j = 1} ^ {m} Y _ {j}\right) \\ &= \frac {1}{(m + n) ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} D \left(X _ {i}\right) + \frac {1}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {m} D \left(Y _ {j}\right) = \frac {n D (X)}{(m + n) ^ {2}} + \frac {m D (Y)}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {n \theta^ {2}}{(m + n) ^ {2}} + \frac {m \cdot 4 \theta^ {2}}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} = \frac {\theta^ {2}}{m + n}. \end{aligned}$或者，注意到$\hat{\theta}=\frac{2\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}+\sum_{j=1}^{m}Y_{j}}{2(m+n)}=\frac{2n\overline{X}+m\overline{Y}}{2(m+n)},$利用$D(\overline{X})=\frac{D(X)}{n}, D(\overline{Y})=\frac{D(Y)}{m}$可得，$\begin{array}{l} D (\hat {\theta}) = D \left[ \frac {2 n \bar {X} + m \bar {Y}}{2 (m + n)} \right] = \frac {n ^ {2} D (\bar {X})}{(m + n) ^ {2}} + \frac {m ^ {2} D (\bar {Y})}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {n ^ {2}}{(m + n) ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {D (X)}{n} + \frac {m ^ {2}}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {D (Y)}{m} \\ = \frac {n \theta^ {2}}{(m + n) ^ {2}} + \frac {m \cdot 4 \theta^ {2}}{4 (m + n) ^ {2}} = \frac {\theta^ {2}}{m + n}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立，且 X服从标准正态分布 N(0,1), Y的概率分布为$P\{Y=0\}=P\{Y=1\}=\frac{1}{2}$. 记$F_{Z}(z)$为随机变量 Z=XY的分布函数，则函数$F_{Z}(z)$的间断点个数为（    )
analysisRich:
解 先用两种方法求$F_{Z}(z).$（法一）由定义知$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{X Y \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{X Y \leqslant z, Y = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X Y \leqslant z, Y = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{z \geqslant 0, Y = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z, Y = 1 \right\} \\ \xlongequal {X, Y \text {相 互 独立}} P \left\{z \geqslant 0, Y = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{z \geqslant 0, Y = 0 \right\} + \frac {1}{2} \Phi (z), \\ \end{array}$其中$\varPhi(z)$为标准正态分布函数.

当$z < 0$时，$P\{z\geqslant 0, Y = 0\} = P(\varnothing) = 0$，故$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2}\Phi (z).$当$z \geqslant 0$时，$P\{z \geqslant 0, Y = 0\} = P\{Y = 0\} = \frac{1}{2}$，故$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2} +\frac{1}{2}\Phi (z).$（法二）由全概率公式知$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{X Y \leqslant z \right\} \\ = P \left\{X Y \leqslant z \mid Y = 0 \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X Y \leqslant z \mid Y = 1 \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y = 1 \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} P \left\{z \geqslant 0 \mid Y = 0 \right\} + \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X \leqslant z \mid Y = 1 \right\} \\ \underline {{\underline {{X , Y}} \text {相 互 独 立}}} \frac {1}{2} P \left\{z \geqslant 0 \right\} + \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X \leqslant z \right\} \\ = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2} \Phi (z), & z < 0, \\ \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \Phi (z), & z \geqslant 0. \end{array} \right. \\ \end{array}$由于$\varPhi(z)$连续，故$F_{z}(z)$仅在$z = 0$处间断.应选B.

questionText: 设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立，且分别服从参数为1与参数为4的指数分布，则$P\{X < Y\} =$（    ）
analysisRich: 解 由题设知，$f_{X}(x)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\mathrm{e}^{-x},&x>0\\ 0,&x\leqslant 0, \end{array} \right. f_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}4\mathrm{e}^{-4y},&y>0\\ 0,&y\leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$由于 X与Y相互独立，故 (X,Y）的概率密度为$f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 4 \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - 4 y}, & x > 0, y > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$记$D=\{(x,y)\mid x<y\}$，则$\begin{aligned} P \{X < Y \} &= \iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {y} 4 \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - 4 y} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 4 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 y} \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- y}\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \left(4 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 y} - 4 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 5 y}\right) \mathrm {d} y = 1 - \frac {4}{5} = \frac {1}{5}. \end{aligned}$应选A.

（X，Y）的概率密度为$f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & 0 < x < 1, 0 < y < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$记$D = \{(x,y)\mid 0\leqslant x\leqslant 1,0\leqslant y\leqslant 1\}$，$P \left\{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1 \right\} = \iint_ {\left\{(x, y) \mid x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1 \right\} \cap D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {\left\{(x, y) \mid x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0 \right\}} 1 \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {\pi}{4}.$应选 D.

设随机变量 X的概率密度为$f ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{9} x^{2},&0<x<3,\\ 0,&\text{其他}.\end{array} \right.$令随机变量$Y=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}2,&X\leqslant 1,\\ X,&1<X<2,\\ 1,&X\geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$I. 求 Y的分布函数；

II. 求概率$P \{ X \leqslant Y \}$
answerRich: (22) (I)$F_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0,& y<1,\\ \frac{y^{3}+18}{27},& 1\leqslant y<2,\\ 1,& y\geqslant 2; \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）$\frac{8}{27}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）记$Y$的分布函数为$F_{Y}(y).$由Y的定义知，$P\{1\leqslant Y\leqslant 2\} = 1.$当$y < 1$时，$F_{Y}(y) = P\{Y\leqslant y\} = 0.$当 1≤y<2时，$\begin{aligned} F _ {Y} (y) &= P \{Y \leqslant y \} = P \{Y < 1 \} + P \{Y = 1 \} + P \{1 < Y \leqslant y \} \\ &= 0 + P \{X \geqslant 2 \} + P \{1 < X \leqslant y \} \\ &= \int_ {2} ^ {3} \frac {1}{9} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {y} \frac {1}{9} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1 9}{2 7} + \frac {y ^ {3} - 1}{2 7} = \frac {y ^ {3} + 1 8}{2 7}. \end{aligned}$当$y \geqslant 2$时，$F_{Y}(y) = P\{Y \leqslant y\} = 1.$因此，$Y$的分布函数为$F_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & y < 1,\\ \frac{y^{3} + 18}{27}, & 1\leqslant y < 2,\\ 1, & y\geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由 Y的定义知，$\begin{aligned} P \{X \leqslant Y \} &= P \{X < Y \} + P \{X = Y \} = P \{X \leqslant 1 \} + P \{1 < X < 2 \} \\ &= P \{X < 2 \} = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {1}{9} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {8}{2 7}. \end{aligned}$（法二）$P \{ X \leqslant Y \} = 1 - P \{ X > Y \} = 1 - P \{ X \geqslant 2 \} = P \{ X < 2 \} = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {1}{9} x^{2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {8}{2 7}.$

analysisRich: 解 由题设知，X，Y不相关. 又由于（X，Y）服从正态分布，故X，Y相互独立. 从而$\begin{aligned} P \{X Y - Y < 0 \} &= P \{(X - 1) Y < 0 \} = P \{X < 1, Y > 0 \} + P \{X > 1, Y < 0 \} \\ &= P \{X < 1 \} \cdot P \{Y > 0 \} + P \{X > 1 \} \cdot P \{Y < 0 \}. \end{aligned}$由$( X, Y ) \sim N ( 1, 0 ; 1, 1 ; 0 )$可知，$X\sim N ( 1, 1 )$$Y\sim N ( 0, 1 )$从而X，Y的概率密度的图形分别关于$x=1$，$x=0$对称，于是$P \{ X < 1 \} = P \{ X > 1 \} = \frac{1}{2}$$P \{ Y < 0 \} = P \{ Y > 0 \} = \frac{1}{2}.$因此，$P \left\{X Y - Y < 0 \right\} = \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2}.$

questionText:
. (本题满分11分)

设二维随机变量 (X,Y)在区域 D = {(x,y) | 0 < x < 1,$x^{2} < y < \sqrt{x}$}上服从均匀分布，令$U=\left\{\begin{array}{l l}1,&X\leqslant Y,\\ 0,&X>Y. \end{array} \right.$I. 写出 (X,Y)的概率密度；

II. 问 U与 X是否相互独立？并说明理由；

III. 求 Z=U+X的分布函数 F(z).
answerRich:
（I）$f ( x,y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}3,&0<x<1,x^{2}<y<\sqrt{x},\\ 0,&\text{其他};\end{array}\right.$（Ⅱ）U与X不相互独立；

（Ⅲ）$F ( z )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}0,&z<0,\\ \frac{3}{2} z^{2}-z^{3},&0\leqslant z<1,\\ 2 ( z-1 )^{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{3}{2} z^{2}+3 z-1,&1\leqslant z<2,\\ 1,&z\geqslant 2.\end{array}\right.$
analysisRich:
（I）区域D如图（a）所示，其面积为$S = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {x} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} \right| _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {2}{3} - \frac {1}{3} = \frac {1}{3}.$又由于$(X, Y)$在区域$D$上服从均匀分布，故$(X, Y)$的概率密度为$f (x, y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 3, & 0 < x < 1, x ^ {2} < y < \sqrt {x}, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$(a)

(b)

（Ⅱ）考虑$P\{U = 0, X\leqslant t\}$$P \{U = 0 \} = P \{X > Y \} = \iint f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2}.$对$t \leqslant 0$，$P\{X \leqslant t\} = 0$，$P\{U = 0, X \leqslant t\} = 0.$于是，$P \left\{U = 0, X \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{U = 0 \right\} \cdot P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\}.$对$t \geqslant 1$，$P\{X \leqslant t\} = 1, P\{U = 0, X \leqslant t\} = P\{U = 0\}$.于是，$P \left\{U = 0, X \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{U = 0 \right\} \cdot P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\}.$对$0 < t < 1$，有效积分区域为图（b）中的蓝色区域.$P \left\{U = 0, X \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{X > Y, X \leqslant t \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {t} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - t ^ {3},$$P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {\sqrt {x}} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {t} 3 \left(\sqrt {x} - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = 2 t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - t ^ {3}.$于是，$\begin{aligned} P \{U = 0, X \leqslant t \} - P \{U = 0 \} \cdot P \{X \leqslant t \} &= \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - t ^ {3} - \frac {1}{2} \left(2 t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - t ^ {3}\right) \\ &= \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2} t ^ {3} - t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \neq 0. (\mathrm {见 注} \textcircled{1}) \end{aligned}$因此，当$0 < t < 1$时，U与X不相互独立.

（Ⅲ）由题设知，$\begin{array}{l} F (z) = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{U + X \leqslant z \right\} \\ = P \left\{U + X \leqslant z, U = 0 \right\} + P \left\{U + X \leqslant z, U = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant z, U = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, U = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\}. \\ \end{array}$当$z < 0$时，$z - 1 < 0$，于是$P\{X\leqslant z,X > Y\} = 0,P\{X\leqslant z - 1,X\leqslant Y\} = 0.$从而$F(z) = 0.$$0 \leqslant z < 1$$z - 1 < 0$$P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\} = 0$$F (z) = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {z} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {z} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {3}{2} z ^ {2} - z ^ {3}.$当$1\leqslant z < 2$时，$0\leqslant z - 1 < 1$$\begin{array}{l} F (z) = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant 1, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {0} ^ {z - 1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x} ^ {\sqrt {x}} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {0} ^ {z - 1} 3 (\sqrt {x} - x) \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} + 2 (z - 1) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {3}{2} (z - 1) ^ {2} = 2 (z - 1) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {3}{2} z ^ {2} + 3 z - 1. \\ \end{array}$当$z\geqslant 2$时，$z - 1\geqslant 1,F(z) = 1.$综上所述，$F (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & z < 0, \\ \frac{3}{2} z^{2} - z^{3}, & 0 \leqslant z < 1, \\ 2 (z - 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{3}{2} z^{2} + 3 z - 1, & 1 \leqslant z < 2, \\ 1, & z \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$

questionText:
设二维随机变量 (X,Y)在区域 D = {(x,y) | 0 < x < 1, x² < y <$\sqrt{x}$}上服从均匀分布，令$U=\left\{\begin{array}{l l}1,&X\leqslant Y,\\ 0,&X>Y. \end{array} \right.$I. 写出 (X,Y)的概率密度；

II. 问 U与 X是否相互独立？并说明理由；

III. 求 Z=U+X的分布函数 F(z).
answerRich:
（I）$f ( x,y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 3, & 0 < x < 1, x^{2} < y < \sqrt{x}, \\ 0, & \text{其他}; \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）$U$与X不相互独立，理由略；

(Ⅲ)$F (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & z < 0, \\ \frac{3}{2} z^{2} - z^{3}, & 0 \leqslant z < 1, \\ 2 (z - 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{3}{2} z^{2} + 3 z - 1, & 1 \leqslant z < 2, \\ 1, & z \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$
analysisRich:
（I）区域 D如图（a）所示，其面积为$S = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {x} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} \right| _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {2}{3} - \frac {1}{3} = \frac {1}{3}.$又由于（X，Y）在区域 D上服从均匀分布，故（X，Y）的概率密度为$f (x, y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 3, & 0 < x < 1, x ^ {2} < y < \sqrt {x}, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$(a)

(b)

（Ⅱ）考虑$P\{U = 0, X\leqslant t\}$$P \{U = 0 \} = P \{X > Y \} = \iint_ {\{(x, y) | x > x \}} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2}.$对$t \leqslant 0$，$P\{X \leqslant t\} = 0$，$P\{U = 0, X \leqslant t\} = 0.$于是，$P \left\{U = 0, X \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{U = 0 \right\} \cdot P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\}.$对$t \geqslant 1$$P\{X \leqslant t\} = 1,P\{U = 0,X \leqslant t\} = P\{U = 0\}$.于是，$P \{U = 0, X \leqslant t \} = P \{U = 0 \} \cdot P \{X \leqslant t \}.$对 0 < t < 1，有效积分区域为图（b）中的蓝色区域.$P \left\{U = 0, X \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{X > Y, X \leqslant t \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {t} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - t ^ {3},$$P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {\sqrt {x}} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {t} 3 \left(\sqrt {x} - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = 2 t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - t ^ {3}.$于是，$\begin{aligned} P \{U = 0, X \leqslant t \} - P \{U = 0 \} \cdot P \{X \leqslant t \} &= \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - t ^ {3} - \frac {1}{2} \left(2 t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - t ^ {3}\right) \\ &= \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2} t ^ {3} - t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \neq 0. (\mathrm {见 注} \textcircled{1}) \end{aligned}$因此，当 0 < t < 1时，U与X不相互独立.

（Ⅲ）由题设知，$\begin{array}{l} F (z) = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{U + X \leqslant z \right\} \\ = P \left\{U + X \leqslant z, U = 0 \right\} + P \left\{U + X \leqslant z, U = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant z, U = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, U = 1 \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\}. \\ \end{array}$当 z < 0时，z-1<0，于是$P\{X\leqslant z,X > Y\}=0,P\{X\leqslant z-1,X\leqslant Y\}=0$从而 F（z）=0.当 0≤z<1时，z-1<0，于是 P$\{X\leqslant z-1,X\leqslant Y\}=0$从而$F (z) = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {z} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {z} 3 \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {3}{2} z ^ {2} - z ^ {3}.$当$1\leqslant z < 2$时，$0\leqslant z - 1 < 1$$\begin{array}{l} F (z) = P \left\{X \leqslant z, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\} \\ = P \left\{X \leqslant 1, X > Y \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z - 1, X \leqslant Y \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {0} ^ {z - 1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x} ^ {\sqrt {x}} 3 \mathrm {d} y = \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {0} ^ {z - 1} 3 (\sqrt {x} - x) \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} + 2 (z - 1) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {3}{2} (z - 1) ^ {2} = 2 (z - 1) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {3}{2} z ^ {2} + 3 z - 1. \\ \end{array}$当$z\geqslant 2$时，$z - 1\geqslant 1,F(z) = 1.$综上所述，$F ( z ) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & z < 0, \\ \frac{3}{2} z^{2} - z^{3}, & 0 \leqslant z < 1, \\ 2 ( z - 1 )^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{3}{2} z^{2} + 3 z - 1, & 1 \leqslant z < 2, \\ 1, & z \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$

answerRich:
（I）$Z$的概率密度为$f_{Z}(z)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}p\mathrm{e}^{z},&z\leqslant 0,\\ (1-p)\mathrm{e}^{-z},&z>0; \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）当$p=\frac{1}{2}$时，X与Z不相关；

（Ⅲ）X与Z不相互独立.
analysisRich:
（I）先计算$Z$的分布函数$F_{Z}(z)$.$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \left\{X Y \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{X \geqslant - z, Y = - 1 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z, Y = 1 \right\} \\ \underline {{\text {独立 性}}} P \left\{X \geqslant - z \right\} P \left\{Y = - 1 \right\} + P \left\{X \leqslant z \right\} P \left\{Y = 1 \right\} \\ = p \left[ 1 - F _ {X} (- z) \right] + (1 - p) F _ {X} (z), \\ \end{array}$其中$F_{X}(x)$是X的分布函数.

于是，Z的概率密度为$f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \left\{p \left[ 1 - F _ {X} (- z) \right] + (1 - p) F _ {X} (z) \right\} ^ {\prime} = p f _ {X} (- z) + (1 - p) f _ {X} (z).$由于$X$服从参数为1的指数分布，故$X$的概率密度为$f_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \mathrm{e}^{-x}, & x > 0, \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$当$z\leqslant 0$时，$-z\geqslant 0,f_{X}(-z) = \mathrm{e}^{z},f_{X}(z) = 0$；当$z > 0$时，$-z < 0,f_{X}(z) = \mathrm{e}^{-z},f_{X}(-z) = 0.$因此，$f _ {Z} (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} p \mathrm {e} ^ {z}, & z \leqslant 0, \\ (1 - p) \mathrm {e} ^ {- z}, & z > 0. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）计算$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Z).$$\begin{aligned} \operatorname {C o v} (X, Z) &= E (X Z) - E (X) E (Z) = E \left(X ^ {2} Y\right) - E (X) E (X Y) \\ \xlongequal {\text {独立性}} E \left(X ^ {2}\right) E (Y) - \left[ E (X) \right] ^ {2} E (Y) \\ &= D (X) E (Y). \end{aligned}$下面分别计算 D（X），E（Y）.

由于$X$服从参数为1的指数分布，故$D(X) = 1.$$E (Y) = 1 \times (1 - p) + (- 1) \times p = 1 - 2 p.$因此，$\operatorname{Cov}(X,Z) = E(Y) = 1 - 2p.$当$p=\frac{1}{2}$时，$\operatorname{Cov}(X,Z)=0$，X与Z不相关.

（Ⅲ）由第（Ⅱ）问可知，当$p\neq \frac{1}{2}$时，X与Z相关，从而不相互独立.

下面只需考虑 p =$\frac{1}{2}$的情况.

（法一）当$p=\frac{1}{2}$时，检验$P\{X < 1,Z < 1\} = P\{X < 1\} P\{Z < 1\}$是否成立.$P \left\{X < 1 \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}.$$\begin{aligned} P \{Z < 1 \} &= P \{X Y < 1 \} = F _ {Z} (1) = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 1 - F _ {X} (- 1) \right] + \frac {1}{2} F _ {X} (1) \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \times (1 - 0) + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}\right). \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} P \{X < 1, Z < 1 \} &= P \{X < 1, X Y < 1 \} = P \{X \leqslant 0, X Y < 1 \} + P \{0 < X < 1, X Y < 1 \} \\ &= P \{0 < X < 1, X Y < 1 \} = P \{0 < X < 1, Y = 1 \} + P \{0 < X < 1, Y = - 1 \} \\ &= P \{0 < X < 1 \} = P \{X < 1 \} = 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}. \end{aligned}$由于$1 - \mathrm{e}^{-1}\neq(1 - \mathrm{e}^{-1})\cdot\left[\frac{1}{2} +\frac{1}{2}(1 - \mathrm{e}^{-1})\right],$故X，Z不相互独立.

（法二）当$p=\frac{1}{2}$时，检验$P\{X > 1,Z < 1\} = P\{X > 1\} P\{Z < 1\}$是否成立.

当 X > 1时，$X Y < 1$等价于$Y < \frac{1}{X}.$又因为此时$\frac{1}{X} < 1$，而Y只可能取1和-1两个值，所以$Y < \frac{1}{X}$能推出$Y = -1.$于是，$P \left\{X > 1 \right\} = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}.$$P \{Z < 1 \} \xlongequal {\text {同 法 一}} \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}\right).$$P \{X > 1, Z < 1 \} = P \{X > 1, X Y < 1 \} = P \left\{X > 1, Y < \frac {1}{X} \right\} = P \{X > 1, Y = - 1 \}$$\stackrel {\text {独立 性}} {=} P \left\{X > 1 \right\} P \left\{Y = - 1 \right\} = \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}.$由于$\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{-1}\neq \mathrm{e}^{-1}\cdot \left[\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-1}\right)\right]$，故X，Z不相互独立.

综上所述，X，Z不相互独立.

questionText:
设随机变量$X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$相互独立，其中$X_{1}$与$X_{2}$均服从标准正态分布，$X_{3}$的概率分布为$P\{X_{3}=0\}=$$P\{X_{3}=1\}=\frac{1}{2}.$$Y=X_{3}X_{1}+(1-X_{3})X_{2}.$I. 求二维随机变量$( X_{1}, Y )$的分布函数，结果用标准正态分布函数$\Phi ( x )$表示；

II. 证明随机变量 Y服从标准正态分布.
answerRich: $(\mathrm {I}) F (x, y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2} \Phi (x) [ \Phi (y) + 1 ], & x \leqslant y, \\ \frac {1}{2} \Phi (y) [ \Phi (x) + 1 ], & x > y; \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）证明略.
analysisRich:
（I）设$(X_{1},Y)$的分布函数为$F(x,y)$.根据定义，$\begin{array}{l} F (x, y) = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {3} X _ {1} + \left(1 - X _ {3}\right) X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} \\ = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {2} \leqslant y, X _ {3} = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {1} \leqslant y, X _ {3} = 1 \right\} \\ \underline {{\text {独立性}}} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} P \left\{X _ {3} = 0 \right\} + P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\} P \left\{X _ {3} = 1 \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} + \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\}. \\ \end{array}$下面分情况讨论.

- 当$x \leqslant y$时，$P\{X_{1} \leqslant x, X_{1} \leqslant y\} = P\{X_{1} \leqslant x\} = \varPhi(x).$$\begin{array}{l} F (x, y) = \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} + \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \Phi (x) \Phi (y) + \frac {1}{2} \Phi (x) = \frac {1}{2} \Phi (x) [ \Phi (y) + 1 ]. \\ \end{array}$- 当$x > y$时，$P\{X_{1}\leqslant x,X_{1}\leqslant y\} = P\{X_{1}\leqslant y\} = \varPhi(y).$$\begin{array}{l} F (x, y) = \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} + \frac {1}{2} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant x, X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \Phi (x) \Phi (y) + \frac {1}{2} \Phi (y) = \frac {1}{2} \Phi (y) [ \Phi (x) + 1 ]. \\ \end{array}$因此，$F ( x,y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac{1}{2} \varPhi ( x ) [ \varPhi ( y ) + 1 ] , & x \leqslant y, \\ \frac{1}{2} \varPhi ( y ) [ \varPhi ( x ) + 1 ] , & x > y. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）计算 Y的边缘分布.$F _ {Y} (y) = F (+ \infty , y) = \frac {1}{2} \Phi (y) [ \Phi (+ \infty) + 1 ] \xlongequal {\Phi (+ \infty) = 1} \Phi (y).$由于$Y$的边缘分布函数为标准正态分布函数，故$Y$服从标准正态分布.

questionText: 设随机变量（X，Y）服从二维正态分布$N \left( 0,0;1,4;-\frac{1}{2} \right)$，则下列随机变量中服从标准正态分布且与 X相互独立的是（    )
analysisRich:
解 由（X，Y）服从二维正态分布$N \left( 0,0;1,4;-\frac{1}{2} \right)$可知，$X\sim N (0,1), Y\sim N (0,4)$，且$\rho_{X Y}=-\frac{1}{2}.$$E ( X )=0,D ( X )=1,E ( Y )=0,D ( Y )=4.$由此可计算$\operatorname{C o v} ( X, Y ).$由协方差的计算公式，可得$\operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = \rho_ {X Y} \sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)} = - \frac {1}{2} \times 1 \times 2 = - 1.$由选项设置，分别考虑$\operatorname{Cov}(X,X+Y),\operatorname{Cov}(X,X-Y)$（由注可知，$(X,X+Y),(X,X-Y)$均服从二维正态分布）.$\operatorname {C o v} (X, X + Y) = \operatorname {C o v} (X, X) + \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 1 - 1 = 0.$$\operatorname {C o v} (X, X - Y) = \operatorname {C o v} (X, X) - \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 1 - (- 1) = 2.$X与X-Y相关，从而不独立，故可以排除选项B、D.

又因为所求随机变量应服从标准正态分布，所以考虑将 X+Y标准化.$E (X + Y) = 0, \quad D (X + Y) = D (X) + D (Y) + 2 \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 1 + 4 - 2 = 3.$由于$D \left[ \frac{\sqrt{5}}{5} (X+Y) \right]=\frac{1}{5} D (X+Y)=\frac{3}{5} \neq 1,D \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3} (X+Y) \right]=\frac{1}{3} D (X+Y)=1$，故可排除选项A，应选C.

袋中有1个红球、2个黑球与3个白球.现有放回地从袋中取两次，每次取一个球.以 X，Y，Z分别表示两次取球所取得的红球、黑球与白球的个数.

I. 求$P\{X=1\mid Z=0\}$；

II. 求二维随机变量（X，Y）的概率分布.

questionText: 设二维随机变量（X，Y）的概率密度为 f(x,y) =$\left\{\begin{array}{ll} \mathrm{e}^{-x}, & 0<y<x, \\ 0, & \mathrm{其他}. \end{array} \right.$I. 求条件概率密度$f_{Y|X}(y|x)$II. 求条件概率$P\{X\leqslant1\mid Y\leqslant1\}$

analysisRich: 解（I）由边缘概率密度的定义可知，当$x > 0$时，$f _ {X} (x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} y = x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x};$当$x\leqslant 0$时，$f _ {X} (x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = 0.$因此，当$f_{X}(x) \neq 0$，即$x > 0$时，$Y$在$X = x$的条件下的条件概率密度为$f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \frac {f (x , y)}{f _ {X} (x)} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{x}, & 0 < y < x, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由条件概率的定义知$\begin{aligned} P \{X \leqslant 1 \mid Y \leqslant 1 \} &= \frac {P \{X \leqslant 1 , Y \leqslant 1 \}}{P \{Y \leqslant 1 \}} = \frac {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} f (x , y) \mathrm {d} y}{\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} f (x , y) \mathrm {d} y} \stackrel {*} {=} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} y}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {y} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x} \\ &= \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \mathrm {d} y} = \frac {- x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x \right.}{- \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} \right.} = \frac {1 - 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} - 2}{\mathrm {e} - 1}. \end{aligned}$（法二）由边缘概率密度的定义可知，当$y > 0$时，$f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {y} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \Big | _ {y} ^ {+ \infty} = \mathrm {e} ^ {- y};$当 y≤0时，$f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = 0.$于是，$P \left\{Y \leqslant 1 \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \mathrm {d} y = 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}.$又因为$P \left\{X \leqslant 1, Y \leqslant 1 \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {1} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = 1 - 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1},$所以由条件概率的定义知，$P \{X \leqslant 1 \mid Y \leqslant 1 \} = \frac {P \{X \leqslant 1 , Y \leqslant 1 \}}{P \{Y \leqslant 1 \}} = \frac {1 - 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} - 2}{\mathrm {e} - 1}.$

questionText: 设二维随机变量$(X, Y)$的概率密度为$f (x, y) = A \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x ^ {2} + 2 x y - y ^ {2}}, (- \infty < x < + \infty , - \infty < y < + \infty).$求常数$A$及条件概率密度$f_{Y|X}(y|x)$.
answerRich: $(2 2) A = \frac {1}{\pi}, f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (x - y) ^ {2}}, y \in (- \infty , + \infty)$
analysisRich: 解 由概率密度的性质可知，$\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=1.$由于$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x ^ {2} + 2 x y - y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} - (y - x) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= A \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (y - x) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y = A \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (y - x) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} (y - x) \\ &= A \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \frac {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t = \sqrt {\pi}}{A \pi}, \end{aligned}$故$A\pi = 1$，从而$A = \frac{1}{\pi}.$由条件概率密度的定义可知，$f_{Y \mid X}(y \mid x) = \frac{f(x,y)}{f_X(x)}.$又由于$f_{X}(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x,y)\mathrm{d} y=\frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-2x^{2}+2xy-y^{2}}\mathrm{d} y=\frac{1}{\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-(y-x)^{2}}\mathrm{d} y=\frac{1}{\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\cdot \sqrt{\pi}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}},$故对任意给定的$x\in(-\infty,+\infty)$，在 X=x的条件下，Y的条件概率密度为$f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \frac {f (x , y)}{f _ {X} (x)} = \frac {\frac {1}{\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x ^ {2} + 2 x y - y ^ {2}}}{\frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} + 2 x y - y ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (x - y) ^ {2}}, y \in (- \infty , + \infty).$

解（I）如图（a）所示，G是一个底为2，高为1的三角形区域，故面积为1.于是二维随机变量 （X，Y）的概率密度为$f (x, y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & (x, y) \in G, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}, \end{array} \right.$这里$G = \{(x,y) \mid y \leqslant x \leqslant 2 - y, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1\}$.

当$x\leqslant 0$时，$f_{X}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y = 0.$当$0 < x\leqslant 1$时，$f_{X}(x) = \int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y = \int_{0}^{x}1\mathrm{d}y = x.$当$1 < x\leqslant 2$时，$f_{X}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y = \int_{0}^{2 - x}1\mathrm{d}y = 2 - x.$当$x > 2$时，$f_{X}(x) = \int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y = 0.$综上所述，$X$的概率密度为$f_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} x, & 0 < x \leqslant 1, \\ 2 - x, & 1 < x \leqslant 2, \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）当$0\leqslant y < 1$时，$f_{Y}(y) = \int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x = \int_{y}^{2 - y}1\mathrm{d}x = 2 - 2y.$当$y < 0$或$y\geqslant 1$时，$f_{Y}(y) = \int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x = 0.$由于条件概率密度$f_{X|Y}(x|y)$是在Y的取值y满足$f_{Y}(y) > 0$的前提下定义的，故我们只考虑$0\leqslant y < 1$的情形.因此，在$Y=y(0\leqslant y < 1)$时，X的条件概率密度为$f _ {X \mid Y} (x \mid y) = \frac {f (x , y)}{f _ {Y} (y)} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 - 2 y}, & y < x < 2 - y, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$

设 (X,Y)是二维随机变量，X的边缘概率密度为$f_{X}(x)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 3x^{2}, & 0<x<1, \\ 0, & \text{其他.} \end{array} \right.$在给定 X=x(0<x<1)的条件下 Y的条件概率密度为$f_{Y|X}(y\mid x)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \frac{3y^{2}}{x^{3}}, & 0<y<x, \\ 0, & \text{其他.} \end{array} \right.$I. 求 (X,Y)的概率密度 f(x,y);

II. 求 Y的边缘概率密度$f_{Y}(y)$III. 求$P\{X>2Y\}$
answerRich: (22) (I)$f ( x,y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{9 y^{2}}{x},&0<y<x,0<x<1,\\ 0,&\text{其他};\end{array} \right.$(Ⅱ)$f_{Y}(y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}-9 y^{2}\ln y,&0<y<1,\\ 0,&\text{其他};\end{array} \right.$(Ⅲ)$\frac{1}{8}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）当$0 < x < 1$时，$f_{X}(x)=3x^{2},f_{Y\mid X}(y\mid x)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_{X}(x)}=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{3y^{2}}{x^{3}},&0<y<x,\\ 0,&\text{其他}, \end{array} \right.$故当$0 < x < 1$时，$f (x, y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {9 y ^ {2}}{x}, & 0 < y < x, \\ 0, & y \leqslant 0 \text {或} y \geqslant x. \end{array} \right.$下面求当$x \leqslant 0$或$x \geqslant 1$时$f(x,y)$的取值.

由于$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {9 y ^ {2}}{x} \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} 3 x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = 1,$故可以认为在$\left\{(x,y)\mid 0 < x < 1,-\infty < y < +\infty\right\}$以外的平面上，即$x\leqslant 0$或$x\geqslant 1$时，$f(x,y)=0.$综上所述，$(X,Y)$的概率密度$f(x,y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{9y^2}{x}, & 0 < y < x,0 < x < 1,\\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问知$Y$的边缘概率密度为$f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \int_ {y} ^ {1} \frac {9 y ^ {2}}{x} \mathrm {d} x, & 0 < y < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其 他} \end{array} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - 9 y ^ {2} \ln y, & 0 < y < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right. \right.$或者，将上述积分次序改为先对$x$积分，再对$y$积分，可得$\begin{array}{l} P \left\{X > 2 Y \right\} = \iint_ {| (x, y) | x > 2 y |} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {2 y} ^ {1} \frac {9 y ^ {2}}{x} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \left(- 9 y ^ {2} \ln 2 y\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ = - 3 y ^ {3} \ln 2 y \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} + \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \frac {6 y ^ {3}}{2 y} \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} 3 y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} y = \frac {1}{8}. \right. \\ \end{array}$
