投保人的损失事件发生时，保险公司的赔付额 Y与投保人的损失额 X的关系为$Y=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}0,&X\leqslant 100\\ X-100,&X>100\end{array} \right.$. 设定损事件发生时，投保人的损失额 X的概率密度为$f(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{2\times 100^{2}}{(100+x)^{3}},&x>0\\ 0,&x\leqslant 0\end{array} \right.$I. 求$P\{Y>0\}$及 EY.

Ⅱ. 这种损失事件在一年内发生的次数记为 N，保险公司在一年内就这种损失事件产生的理赔次数记为 M，假设 N服从参数为8的泊松分布，在$N=n$（$n\geqslant1$）的条件下，M服从二项分布$B(n,p)$，其中$p=P\{Y>0\}$，求 M的概率分布.
answerRich: （I）$P \left\{Y > 0\right\}=\frac{1}{4}, E (Y)=50;$（Ⅱ）M服从参数为2的泊松分布.
analysisRich: 解（I）根据 Y的定义，$\begin{aligned} P \{Y > 0 \} &= P \{X > 1 0 0 \} = \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {2 \times 1 0 0 ^ {2}}{(1 0 0 + x) ^ {3}} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {2 \times 1 0 0 ^ {2}}{2} (1 0 0 + x) ^ {- 2} \Bigg | _ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} \\ &= - \frac {1 0 0 ^ {2}}{(1 0 0 + x) ^ {2}} \Bigg | _ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$由于随机变量$Y$是随机变量$X$的函数，故根据数学期望的定义，$\begin{aligned} E (Y) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} (x - 1 0 0) f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {2 \times 1 0 0 ^ {2} (x - 1 0 0)}{(1 0 0 + x) ^ {3}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= - 1 0 0 ^ {2} \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} (x - 1 0 0) \mathrm {d} \left[ (1 0 0 + x) ^ {- 2} \right] = - 1 0 0 ^ {2} \left[ \frac {x - 1 0 0}{(1 0 0 + x) ^ {2}} \right| _ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{(1 0 0 + x) ^ {2}} ] \\ &= \frac {- 1 0 0 ^ {2}}{1 0 0 + x} \Big | _ {1 0 0} ^ {+ \infty} = 0 - \left(- \frac {1 0 0 ^ {2}}{2 0 0}\right) = 5 0. \end{aligned}$（Ⅱ）由于$N$服从参数为8的泊松分布，故$P\{N = n\} = \frac{8^{n}\mathrm{e}^{-8}}{n!}$，进一步可得$P\{N = 0\} = \mathrm{e}^{-8}$由于当$N = 0$时，$M$必然等于0，故$P\{M = 0\mid N = 0\} = 1$，从而$P \{M = 0, N = 0 \} = P \{M = 0 \mid N = 0 \} P \{N = 0 \} = 1 \cdot P \{N = 0 \} = \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}.$由 M的定义可知，当$M=k$时，$N=n\geqslant k$由在$N=n(n\geqslant 1)$的条件下，M服从二项分布$B(n,p)$可得，$P \left\{M = k \mid N = n \right\} = \mathrm {C} _ {n} ^ {k} p ^ {k} (1 - p) ^ {n - k}, \quad k = 0, 1, \dots , n, n = 1, 2, \dots .$由条件概率公式以及 p=$\frac{1}{4}$可得$\begin{aligned} P \{M = k, N = n \} &= P \{M = k \mid N = n \} P \{N = n \} = C _ {n} ^ {k} p ^ {k} (1 - p) ^ {n - k} \frac {8 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}}{n !} \\ &= \frac {n !}{k ! (n - k) !} \cdot \left(\frac {1}{4}\right) ^ {k} \cdot \left(\frac {3}{4}\right) ^ {n - k} \cdot \frac {8 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}}{n !} = \frac {3 ^ {n - k} 2 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}}{k ! (n - k) !} \\ &= \frac {6 ^ {n - k} 2 ^ {k} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}}{k ! (n - k) !}. \end{aligned}$由此可得，当$k\neq 0$时，$\begin{aligned} P \{M = k \} &= \sum_ {n = k} ^ {\infty} P \{M = k, N = n \} = \sum_ {n = k} ^ {\infty} \frac {6 ^ {n - k} 2 ^ {k} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8}}{k ! (n - k) !} = \frac {2 ^ {k} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2}}{k !} \sum_ {n = k} ^ {\infty} \frac {6 ^ {n - k} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 6}}{(n - k) !} \\ &= \frac {2 ^ {k} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2}}{k !} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {6 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 6}}{n !}. \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} P \{M = 0 \} &= \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} P \{M = 0, N = n \} = \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} P \{M = 0, N = n \} = \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {6 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 6}}{n !} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2} \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {6 ^ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 6}}{n !}. \end{aligned}$由泊松分布的定义可知，服从参数为6的泊松分布的随机变量Z的分布律为$P\{Z=n\}=\frac{6^{n}\mathrm{e}^{-6}}{n!}.$由分布律的性质可得，$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{6^{n}\mathrm{e}^{-6}}{n!}=1.$于是，$P\{M=k\}=\frac{2^{k}\mathrm{e}^{-2}}{k!}, k=0,1,2,\dots.$因此，M服从参数为2的泊松分布.

questionText:
设总体 X的分布函数为$F ( x ; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm{e}^{- \frac {x^{2}}{\theta}}, & x \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & x < 0, \end{array} \right.$其中$\theta$是未知参数且大于零.$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots , X_{n}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本.

I. 求$E ( X )$与$E \left( X^{2} \right)$II. 求$\theta$的最大似然估计量$\hat{\theta}_{n}$III. 是否存在实数 a，使得对任何$\varepsilon > 0$，都有$\lim_{n \to \infty} P \{ | \hat{\theta}_{n}-a | \geqslant \varepsilon \}=0$？
answerRich:
(23) (I)$E ( X )=\frac{\sqrt{\pi\theta}}{2}, E ( X^{2} )=\theta;$(Ⅱ)$\widehat{\theta}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i^2$;

（Ⅲ）存在实数$a = \theta$，使得对任何$\varepsilon > 0$，都有$\lim_{n\to \infty}P\{|\widehat{\theta}_n - a| \geqslant \varepsilon \} = 0.$
analysisRich: 解（I）由题设知，X的概率密度$f ( x ; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \frac{2 x}{\theta} \mathrm{e}^{- \frac{x^{2}}{\theta}}, & x \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & x < 0, \end{array} \right.$于是$\begin{aligned} E (X) &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {2 x}{\theta} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {d} \left(- \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}}\right) = - x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= 0 + \sqrt {\theta} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {x}{\sqrt {\theta}}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {x}{\sqrt {\theta}}\right) \stackrel {t = \frac {x}{\sqrt {\theta}}} {=} \sqrt {\theta} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \sqrt {\theta} \cdot \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2} = \frac {\sqrt {\pi \theta}}{2}, \quad \text {这 里 利用 了 等 式} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2}. \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} E \left(X ^ {2}\right) &= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {2 x}{\theta} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} \mathrm {d} x = \theta \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}\right) \stackrel {u = \frac {x ^ {2}}{\theta}} {=} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u \\ &= \theta \left(- u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u\right) = \theta . \end{aligned}$（Ⅱ）设$x_{1}, x_{2}, \dots, x_{n}$是来自于样本$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$的一个样本值，则似然函数为$L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f \left(x _ {i}; \theta\right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2 ^ {n} x _ {1} x _ {2} \cdots x _ {n}}{\theta^ {n}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x _ {1} ^ {2} + x _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + x _ {n} ^ {2}}{\theta}}, & x _ {1} \geqslant 0, x _ {2} \geqslant 0, \dots , x _ {n} \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$当$x_{1} > 0,x_{2} > 0,\dots ,x_{n} > 0$时，$\ln L (\theta) = \ln \left(2 ^ {n} x _ {1} x _ {2} \dots x _ {n}\right) - n \ln \theta - \frac {x _ {1} ^ {2} + x _ {2} ^ {2} + \dots + x _ {n} ^ {2}}{\theta}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left[\ln L(\theta)\right]}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=0$即有$-\frac{n}{\theta}+\frac{x_{1}^{2}+x_{2}^{2}+\cdots+x_{n}^{2}}{\theta^{2}}=0$解得$\theta=\frac{x_{1}^{2}+x_{2}^{2}+\cdots+x_{n}^{2}}{n}$，于是$\theta$的最大似然估计量为$\widehat {\theta} _ {n} = \frac {X _ {1} ^ {2} + X _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + X _ {n} ^ {2}}{n} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} ^ {2}.$（Ⅲ）由$X_{1},X_{2},\dots ,X_{n}$独立同分布知，$X_{1}^{2},X_{2}^{2},\dots ,X_{n}^{2}$独立同分布.又由（I）知，$E\left(X_{i}^{2}\right) = E\left(X^{2}\right) = \theta$，故由辛钦大数定律知，对任意$\varepsilon >0$，有$\lim_{n\to \infty}P\left\{\left|\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_{i}^{2} - \theta\right| < \varepsilon\right\} = 1$，从而$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} P \left\{\left| \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} ^ {2} - \theta \right| \geqslant \varepsilon \right\} = 0,$即存在实数$a = \theta$，使得对任何$\varepsilon > 0$，都有$\lim P\{ |\widehat{\theta}_n - a | \geqslant \varepsilon \} = 0.$

依次分析各选项.

事实上，若$2 \left(X_{n}-X_{1}\right)^{2}\sim \mathcal{X}^{2}(m)$，则$E \left[ 2 \left(X _ {n} - X _ {1}\right) ^ {2} \right] = m, \quad D \left[ 2 \left(X _ {n} - X _ {1}\right) ^ {2} \right] = 2 m.$但由$\frac{\left(X_{n}-X_{1}\right)^{2}}{2}\sim X^{2}(1)$知，$E \left[ \frac {\left(X _ {n} - X _ {1}\right) ^ {2}}{2} \right] = 1, \quad D \left[ \frac {\left(X _ {n} - X _ {1}\right) ^ {2}}{2} \right] = 2,$从而$E[2(X_{n}-X_{1})^{2}]=4,D[2(X_{n}-X_{1})^{2}]=32.$这与$D[2(X_{n}-X_{1})^{2}]=2E[2(X_{n}-X_{1})^{2}]$矛盾，故$2(X_{n}-X_{1})^{2}$不服从$\chi^{2}$分布.

令$Z = X_{1} - X_{2}$，则$Z\sim N(0,2\sigma^{2})$，从而Z的概率密度$f(z) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\cdot \sqrt{2}\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z^{2}}{4\sigma^{2}}}$$\begin{array}{l} E (\mid Z \mid) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | z | f (z) \mathrm {d} z = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \sqrt {2} \sigma} \cdot z \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} z = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi} \sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} \left(z ^ {2}\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi} \sigma} \cdot \left(- 4 \sigma^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{4 \sigma^ {2}}}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {2}{\sqrt {\pi}} \sigma . \\ \end{array}$由此可得$E (\hat {\sigma}) = E \left(a \mid X _ {1} - X _ {2} \mid\right) = E \left(a \mid Z \mid\right) = \frac {2 a}{\sqrt {\pi}} \sigma .$又因为$E(\hat{\sigma}) = \sigma$，即$\frac{2a}{\sqrt{\pi}}\sigma = \sigma$，所以$a=\frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}.$因此，应选A.

questionText: 设事件 A与事件 B互不相容，则（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由于事件 A与事件 B互不相容，故$A \cap B=\varnothing$.又因为$\overline{A}\cup \overline{B}=\overline{A\cap B}$，所以$P(\overline{A}\cup \overline{B})= P(\overline{A\cap B})=1-P(AB)=1-0=1.$应选 D.

下面我们分别说明选项A、B、C不正确.

由于$\overline{A}\cap \overline{B}=\overline{A\cup B}$，故$P(\overline{A}\overline{B})=P(\overline{A\cup B})=1-P(A\cup B).$当$P(A\cup B)\neq 1$时，$P(\overline{A}\overline{B})\neq 0.$选项A不正确.

若$P ( A ) \neq 0$且$P ( B ) \neq 0$，则$P ( A B ) = 0 \neq P ( A ) P ( B ).$选项B不正确.

由于$A \cap B = \varnothing$，即$A \subseteq \overline{B}$，故$P(A) \leqslant P(\overline{B}) = 1 - P(B)$.选项C不正确.

questionText: 设 A,B,C是随机事件，A与C互不相容，$P ( A B )=\frac{1} {2}, P ( C )=\frac{1} {3}$，则$P ( A B \mid \bar{C})=$___
analysisRich: 解 由条件概率的定义可知，$P ( A B \mid \bar{C})=\frac{P ( A B \bar{C})}{P (\bar{C})}=\frac{P ( A B \bar{C})}{1-P(C)}.$又由于 A与C互不相容，即$A \cap C=\varnothing$，故$A \cap B \subseteq A \subseteq \bar{C}$，从而$A \cap B \cap \bar{C}=A \cap B, P ( A B \bar{C})=P ( A B ).$因此，$P ( A B \mid \bar{C})=\frac{P ( A B \bar{C})}{1-P(C)}=\frac{P ( A B)}{1-P(C)}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{1-\frac{1}{3}}=\frac{3}{4}.$

questionText: 设随机事件 A与 B相互独立，且$P ( B )=0. 5, P ( A-B)=0. 3$，则$P ( B-A )=$(    )

questionText: 设 A,B为两个随机事件，且$0 < P ( A ) < 1, 0 < P ( B ) < 1$，如果$P ( A \mid B )=1$，则（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由题设知，$P ( A \mid B ) = \frac { P ( A B ) } { P ( B ) } = 1.$于是$P ( A B ) = P ( B ).$因此，$P (A \cup B) = P (A) + P (B) - P (A B) \xlongequal {P (A B) = P (B)} P (A),$$P (\bar {B} \mid \bar {A}) = \frac {P (\bar {B} \bar {A})}{P (\bar {A})} = \frac {P (\overline {{A \cup B}})}{P (\bar {A})} = \frac {1 - P (A \cup B)}{1 - P (A)} = \frac {1 - P (A)}{1 - P (A)} = 1,$$P (A \mid \bar {B}) = \frac {P \left(A \bar {B}\right)}{P (\bar {B})} = \frac {P (A) - P (A B)}{P (\bar {B})} = \frac {P (A) - P (B)}{1 - P (B)},$$P (B \mid A) = \frac {P (B A)}{P (A)} = \frac {P (B)}{P (A)}.$综上所述，选项A正确.应选A.

也可以如下举反例说明选项B、C、D均不正确.

设$B\subseteq A$，$P(A) = \frac{1}{2}$，$P(B) = \frac{1}{4}$，则$P(A\mid \overline{B}) = \frac{1}{3}$，$P(A\cup B) = \frac{1}{2}$，$P(B\mid A) = \frac{1}{2}$.

questionText: 设袋中有红、白、黑球各1个，从中有放回地取球，每次取1个，直到三种颜色的球都取到时停止，则取球次数恰好为4的概率为___
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于第4次取到的球可以为红、白、黑球中的任一种，故第4次取球有$C_{3}^{1}$种可能的情况.第4次取球的颜色固定后，前三次取球只剩下两种颜色可选，且两种颜色的球都要被取到.于是在前三次取球中，一定有两次取到剩下某一种颜色的球，有一次取到剩下的另一种颜色的球，从而前三次取球有$C_{2}^{1}\cdot C_{3}^{2}$种可能的情况. 因此，取球次数恰好为4的情况共有$\mathrm{C}_{3}^{1}\cdot \mathrm{C}_{2}^{1}\cdot \mathrm{C}_{3}^{2}$种，取球次数恰好为4的概率为$\frac{\mathrm{C}_{3}^{1}\cdot \mathrm{C}_{2}^{1}\cdot \mathrm{C}_{3}^{2}}{3^{4}}=\frac{2}{9}.$满足题设条件的取球情况如下表.
第4次取球前三次取球

黑黑白黑白黑白黑黑
白红红黑红黑红黑红红
黑黑红黑红黑红黑黑
黑红红白红白红白红红
白白红白红白红白白
（法二）因为恰好四次便可取完三种颜色的球，所以前三次中一定有同一颜色的球取了两次.前三次中任取两次共有$C_{3}^{2}$种情况，这两次选取的颜色共有$C_{3}^{1}$种情况；前三次中剩下的一次取剩下的两种颜色中的一种，共$C_{2}^{1}$种情况；前三次的球选好后，第四次的球只剩一种选择.因此，共有$C_{3}^{2}\cdot C_{3}^{1}\cdot C_{2}^{1}$种情况，所求概率为$\frac{C_{3}^{2}\cdot C_{3}^{1}\cdot C_{2}^{1}}{3^{4}}=\frac{2}{9}.$

questionText: 设 A,B为随机事件.若$0 < P ( A ) < 1, 0 < P ( B ) < 1$，则$P ( A \mid B ) > P ( A \mid \bar{B} )$的充分必要条件是（    )
analysisRich:
解 （法一）由题设知，$P (A \mid B) > P (A \mid \bar {B}) \Leftrightarrow \frac {P (A B)}{P (B)} > \frac {P (A \bar {B})}{P (\bar {B})} \Leftrightarrow \frac {P (A B)}{P (A B) + P (\bar {A} B)} > \frac {P (A \bar {B})}{P (A \bar {B}) + P (\bar {A} \bar {B})}.$记$P ( A B ) = a,P(\overline{A} B)=b,P(A\overline{B})=c,P(\overline{A}\overline{B})=d$，则$\frac{P(A B)}{P(A B)+P(\overline{A} B)} >\frac{P(A\overline{B})}{P(A\overline{B})+P(\overline{A}\overline{B})},$即$\frac{a}{a+b} >\frac{c}{c+d},$由于 0 < P(A) < 1,0 < P(B) < 1，故 a+b=P(B),c+d=P$\overline{{B}}$, a+c=P(A),b+d=P$\overline{{A}}$均大于0.于是，$\frac {a}{a + b} > \frac {c}{c + d} \Leftrightarrow a (c + d) > c (a + b) \Leftrightarrow a d > b c.$ad > bc等价于$a b + a d > a b + b c, \quad \text {即} \frac {a}{a + c} > \frac {b}{b + d}, \quad \text {也 即} P (B \mid A) > P (B \mid \bar {A}).$因此，应选A.

（法二）由题设知，$\begin{array}{l} P (A \mid B) > P (A \mid \bar {B}) \Leftrightarrow \frac {P (A B)}{P (B)} > \frac {P (A \bar {B})}{P (\bar {B})} = \frac {P (A) - P (A B)}{1 - P (B)} \\ \Leftrightarrow P (A B) [ 1 - P (B) ] > [ P (A) - P (A B) ] P (B) \\ \end{array}$$\Leftrightarrow P (A B) > P (A) P (B).$调换 A,B的位置，同上可得$P (B \mid A) > P (B \mid \bar {A}) \Leftrightarrow P (B A) > P (B) P (A).$又$P ( A B ) = P ( B A )$，故$P (A \mid B) > P (A \mid \bar {B}) \Leftrightarrow P (B \mid A) > P (B \mid \bar {A}).$因此，应选A.

questionText: 设 A,B,C为三个随机事件，且 A与 C相互独立，B与 C相互独立，则 A$\cup$B与 C相互独立的充分必要条件是（    ）
analysisRich: 由已知条件知，$P ( A C ) = P ( A ) P ( C )$$P ( B C ) = P ( B ) P ( C )$计算 P（（AUB）$\cap C ）$，得$\begin{aligned} P ((A \cup B) \cap C) &= P ((A \cap C) \cup (B \cap C)) \\ &= P (A \cap C) + P (B \cap C) - P ((A \cap C) \cap (B \cap C)) \\ &= P (A C) + P (B C) - P (A \cap B \cap C) \\ &= P (A) P (C) + P (B) P (C) - P (A \cap B \cap C). \end{aligned}$另一方面，事件 A U B与事件 C相互独立等价于$\begin{aligned} P ((A \cup B) \cap C) &= P (A \cup B) P (C) = [ P (A) + P (B) - P (A B) ] P (C) \\ &= P (A) P (C) + P (B) P (C) - P (A B) P (C). \end{aligned}$因此，事件 A$\cup$B与事件 C相互独立等价于$P ( A B ) P ( C )=P ( A \cap B \cap C )=P ( A B C )$即事件 AB与事件 C相互独立.应选C.

analysisRich: 解 由于事件 A与B相互独立，故$P ( A B )=P ( A ) P ( B ).$由于事件 A与C相互独立，故$P ( A C )=P ( A ) P ( C ).$根据事件运算的分配律，$P ( A C \cap( A B \cup C) )=P((A C \cap A B)\cup( A C \cap C))\overset{B C=\varnothing}{=}P( A C ).$根据条件概率的公式，$\begin{aligned} P (A C \mid A B \cup C) &= \frac {P (A C \cap (A B \cup C))}{P (A B \cup C)} = \frac {P (A C)}{P (A B \cup C)} = \frac {P (A) P (C)}{P (A B) + P (C) - P (A B C)} \\ &= \frac {P (A) P (C)}{P (A) P (B) + P (C) - 0} = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$代入$P ( A )=P ( B )=\frac{1}{2}$，可得$\frac{\frac{1}{2} P ( C )}{\frac{1}{4}+P ( C )}=\frac{1}{4}.$解得$P ( C )=\frac{1}{4}.$

questionText: 设 A,B为随机事件，且$0 < P ( B ) < 1$，下列命题中为假命题的是（    )

textOptions.A: 若$P ( A \mid B )=P ( A )$，则$P ( A \mid \bar{B})=P ( A )$
textOptions.C: 若$P ( A \mid B )>P ( A \mid \bar{B})$，则$P ( A \mid B )>P ( A )$
textOptions.D: 若$P ( A \mid A \cup B )>P ( \bar{A} \mid A \cup B)$，则$P ( A )>P ( B )$

analysisRich:
解 考虑选项 D.$P (A \mid A \cup B) = \frac {P (A \cap (A \cup B))}{P (A \cup B)} = \frac {P (A)}{P (A) + P (B) - P (A B)},$$P (\bar {A} \mid A \cup B) = \frac {P (\bar {A} \cap (A \cup B))}{P (A \cup B)} = \frac {P (\bar {A} B)}{P (A) + P (B) - P (A B)} = \frac {P (B) - P (A B)}{P (A) + P (B) - P (A B)}.$若$P(A \mid A \cup B) > P(\overline{A} \mid A \cup B)$，则$P(A) > P(B) - P(AB)$. 但这并不能保证$P(A) > P(B)$.由此出发考虑选项D的反例.例如：$A = B$，则$P(A \mid A \cup B) = 1 > 0 = P(\overline{A} \mid A \cup B)$，但$P(A) = P(B)$.

因此，应选D.

下面说明选项A、B、C不正确.

选项A：由于$P ( A )=P ( A \mid B )=\frac{P ( A B )}{P ( B )}$，故$P ( A B )=P ( A ) P ( B )$，从而A，B独立.由A，B独立可得A，$\overline{B}$独立，故$P ( A \mid \overline{B})=P ( A ).$选项A成立.

选项B：若$P ( A \mid B ) > P ( A )$，即$\frac{P ( A B )}{P ( B )} > P ( A )$，则$P ( A B ) > P ( A ) P ( B ).$$\begin{aligned} P (\bar {A} \mid \bar {B}) &= \frac {P (\bar {A} \bar {B})}{P (\bar {B})} = \frac {1 - P (A \cup B)}{1 - P (B)} = \frac {1 - P (A) - P (B) + P (A B)}{1 - P (B)} \\ > \frac {1 - P (A) - P (B) + P (A) P (B)}{1 - P (B)} &= 1 - P (A) = P (\bar {A}). \end{aligned}$选项B成立.

选项C：若$P ( A \mid B ) > P ( A \mid \bar{B} )$，即$\frac{P ( A B )}{P ( B )} >\frac{P ( A B )}{P (\bar{B})}$，则$\frac{P ( A B )}{P ( B )} >\frac{P ( A ) - P ( A B )}{1 - P ( B )}.$由此可得$P ( A B ) - P ( B ) P ( A B ) > P ( A ) P ( B ) - P ( B ) P ( A B )$即$P ( A B ) > P ( A ) P ( B ).$于是，$P ( A ) < \frac { P ( A B ) } { P ( B ) } = P ( A \mid B ) .$选项C成立.

analysisRich: 由于$A,B$互不相容，$A,C$互不相容，$B,C$相互独立，故$P (A B) = 0, \quad P (A C) = 0, \quad P (B C) = P (B) P (C) = \frac {1}{9}, \quad P (A B C) = 0.$由条件概率公式，$\begin{aligned} P (B \cup C \mid A \cup B \cup C) &= \frac {P [ (B \cup C) \cap (A \cup B \cup C) ]}{P (A \cup B \cup C)} = \frac {P (B \cup C)}{P (A \cup B \cup C)} \\ &= \frac {P (B) + P (C) - P (B C)}{P (A) + P (B) + P (C) - P (A B) - P (B C) - P (A C) + P (A B C)} \\ &= \frac {\frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{3} - \frac {1}{9}}{\frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{3} - \frac {1}{9}} = \frac {5}{8}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设 A,B为两个随机事件，且 A与 B相互独立，已知$P ( A )=2 P ( B )$$P ( A \cup B )=\frac{5}{8}$，则在事件 A,B至少有一个发生的条件下，A,B中恰有一个发生的概率为___
analysisRich: 解 根据条件概率公式，A，B中至少有一个发生的条件下，A，B中恰好有一个发生的概率为$\begin{aligned} P \left(A \bar {B} \cup \bar {A} B \mid A \cup B\right) &= \frac {P \left[ \left(A \bar {B} \cup \bar {A} B\right) \cap (A \cup B) \right]}{P (A \cup B)} = \frac {P \left(A \bar {B} \cup \bar {A} B\right)}{P (A \cup B)} \\ &= \frac {P \left(A \bar {B}\right) + P \left(\bar {A} B\right)}{P \left(A \cup B\right)} \xlongequal {\text {独立 性}} \frac {P (A) P (\bar {B}) + P (\bar {A}) P (B)}{P (A \cup B)}. \end{aligned}$下面计算$P ( A ) , P ( B )$由于 A，B相互独立，故$P ( A B )=P ( A ) P ( B )$，结合$P ( A )=2 P ( B )$可得$\frac{5}{8}=P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=3P(B)-2[P(B)]^{2}.$整理可得$1 6 \left[ P (B) \right]^{2}-2 4 P (B)+5=0$即$\left[ 4 P (B)-1 \right] \left[ 4 P (B)-5 \right]=0.$解得$P (B)=\frac{1}{4}$舍去$P (B)=\frac{5}{4}).$进一步可得$P (A)=2 P (B)=\frac{1}{2}.$因此$P \left(A \bar {B} \cup \bar {A} B \mid A \cup B\right) = \frac {P (A) P (\bar {B}) + P (\bar {A}) P (B)}{P (A \cup B)} = \frac {\frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {3}{4} + \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{4}}{\frac {5}{8}} = \frac {4}{5}.$

questionText: 设 A,B,C 为三个随机事件，且 A 与 B 相互独立，B 与 C 相互独立，A 与 C 互不相容，已知$P ( A )=P ( C )=\frac{1}{4},$$P ( B )=\frac{1}{2}$，则在事件 A,B,C 至少有一个发生的条件下，A,B,C 中恰有一个发生的概率为___
analysisRich: 解 由 A与B相互独立，B与C相互独立可得$P ( A B )=P ( A ) P ( B ) , P ( B C )=P ( B ) P ( C ).$由 A与C互不相容可得$A \cap C=\varnothing$由此可得$P ( A C)=0.$所求概率为$P ( A \overline{B} \overline{C} \cup \overline{A} \overline{B} \overline{C} \cup \overline{A} \overline{B} C \mid A \cup B \cup C).$根据条件概率公式，$P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C \mid A \cup B \cup C\right) = \frac {P \left[ \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C\right) \cap \left(A \cup B \cup C\right) \right]}{P \left(A \cup B \cup C\right)}.$由于$A\overline{B}\overline{C},\overline{A}B\overline{C},\overline{A}\overline{B}C$均包含于$A\cup B\cup C$，故$P \left[ \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C\right) \cap (A \cup B \cup C) \right] = P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C\right).$又因为这三个事件互不相容，故$P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C\right) = P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C}\right) + P \left(\bar {A} B \bar {C}\right) + P \left(\bar {A} \bar {B} C\right).$由$A \cap C = \varnothing$可得$A \subseteq \overline{C}, C \subseteq \overline{A}$，于是$A\overline{B}\overline{C} = A\overline{B},\overline{A}\overline{B}C = \overline{B}C.$进一步可得$P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C}\right) = P \left(A \bar {B}\right) \stackrel {\mathrm {独立 性}} {=} P (A) P (\bar {B}) = \frac {1}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{8},$$P (\bar {A} \bar {B} C) = P (\bar {B} C) \stackrel {\text {独立 性}} {=} P (\bar {B}) P (C) = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{4} = \frac {1}{8}.$此外，$\begin{aligned} P (\bar {A} B \bar {C}) &= P [ B \cap (\overline {{A \cup C}}) ] = P (B) - P [ B \cap (A \cup C) ] = P (B) - P (A B \cup B C) \\ &= P (B) - P (A B) - P (B C) \xlongequal {\text {独立性}} P (B) - P (A) P (B) - P (B) P (C) \\ &= P (B) [ 1 - P (A) - P (C) ] = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} P (A \cup B \cup C) &= P (A) + P (B) + P (C) - P (A B) - P (B C) - P (A C) + P (A B C) \\ \frac {P (A C) = 0}{P (A B C) = 0} P (A) + P (B) + P (C) - P (A) P (B) - P (B) P (C) \\ &= \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{4} - \frac {1}{4} \cdot \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{4} = \frac {3}{4}. \end{aligned}$结合（1）式，（2）式可得$P \left(A \bar {B} \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} B \bar {C} \cup \bar {A} \bar {B} C \mid A \cup B \cup C\right) = \left(\frac {1}{8} + \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{8}\right) / \frac {3}{4} = \frac {2}{3}.$

questionText: 设$f_{1}(x)$为标准正态分布的概率密度，$f_{2}(x)$为$[-1,3]$上均匀分布的概率密度，若$f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a f _ {1} (x), & x \leqslant 0, \\ b f _ {2} (x), & x > 0 \end{array} \right. \quad (a > 0, b > 0)$为概率密度，则 a,b应满足（    ）
analysisRich: 解 由于标准正态分布的概率密度的图形关于 x=0对称，故$\int_{0}^{+\infty} f_{1}(x)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{-\infty}^{0} f_{1}(x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}.$又由题设知，$f_{2}(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{4},&-1\leqslant x\leqslant 3,\\ 0,&\text{其他}.\end{array} \right.$由于 f(x)为概率密度，故$1=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{-\infty}^{0} a f_{1}(x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{+\infty} b f_{2}(x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2} a+\int_{0}^{3} \frac{b}{4}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2} a+\frac{3}{4} b,$即$\frac{1}{2} a+\frac{3}{4} b=1$从而2a+3b=4.应选A.

questionText: 设$F_{1}(x)$与$F_{2}(x)$为两个分布函数，其相应的概率密度$f_{1}(x)$与$f_{2}(x)$是连续函数，则必为概率密度的是（    )
analysisRich: 解 由分布函数和概率密度的性质知，$f_{1}(x)F_{2}(x) + f_{2}(x)F_{1}(x)\geqslant 0$，且$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ f _ {1} (x) F _ {2} (x) + f _ {2} (x) F _ {1} (x) \right] \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ F _ {1} (x) F _ {2} (x) \right] ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= F _ {1} (+ \infty) F _ {2} (+ \infty) - F _ {1} (- \infty) F _ {2} (- \infty) \\ &= 1 - 0 = 1. \end{aligned}$因此，$f_{1}(x)F_{2}(x) + f_{2}(x)F_{1}(x)$为概率密度.应选D.

questionText: 设$X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$是随机变量，且$X_{1}\sim N(0,1), X_{2}\sim N\left(0,2^{2}\right), X_{3}\sim N\left(5,3^{2}\right), p_{i}=P\left\{-2\leqslant X_{i}\leqslant 2\right\} (i=1,2,3)$则（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由$X_{2} \sim N(0,2^{2}), X_{3} \sim N(5,3^{2})$知，$\frac{X_2}{2} \sim N(0,1), \frac{X_3 - 5}{3} \sim N(0,1)$.于是，$p_{1} = P\{-2 \leqslant X_{1} \leqslant 2\} = \Phi (2) - \Phi (-2) = 1 - \Phi (-2) - \Phi (-2) = 1 - 2\Phi (-2),$$p_{2} = P\{-2 \leqslant X_{2} \leqslant 2\} = P\{-1 \leqslant \frac{X_{2}}{2} \leqslant 1\} = \Phi (1) - \Phi (-1) = 1 - 2\Phi (-1),$$p_{3} = P\{-2 \leqslant X_{3} \leqslant 2\} = P\{- \frac{7}{3} \leqslant \frac{X_3 - 5}{3} \leqslant -1\} = \Phi (-1) - \Phi \left(-\frac{7}{3}\right).$于$\Phi (-1) > \Phi (-2)$，故$p_{1} > p_{2}$.

由于$\varPhi(-1) > \varPhi(-2)$，故$p_1 > p_2$。

设标准正态分布的概率密度为$\varphi(x)$，则$\varphi(x)$为偶函数，且在$(-\infty ,0]$上单调增加（如图所示）.又由于$p_{2}=\int_{-1}^{1}\varphi(x)\mathrm{d}x, p_{3}=$$\int_{-\frac{7}{3}}^{-1}\varphi(x)\mathrm{d}x$，而$\varphi(x)$在（-1,1）上的取值都大于$\varphi(x)$在$\left(-\frac{7}{3},-1\right)$上的取值，且积分区间的长度满足$|1-(-1)|> \left| -1-\left(-\frac{7}{3}\right) \right|$，故$p_{2}>p_{3}.$综上所述，$p_{1}>p_{2}>p_{3}.$应选A.

questionText: 设随机变量$Y$服从参数为 1 的指数分布,$a$为常数且大于零, 则$P\{Y \leqslant a+1 \mid Y > a\} =$___
analysisRich: 解 由题设知，Y的概率密度为$f_{Y}(y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\mathrm{e}^{-y},&y>0,\\ 0,&y\leqslant 0.\end{array}\right.$又 a > 0，故$P \left\{Y \leqslant a + 1 \mid Y > a \right\} = \frac {P \left\{a < Y \leqslant a + 1 \right\}}{P \left\{Y > a \right\}} = \frac {\int_ {a} ^ {a + 1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \mathrm {d} y}{\int_ {a} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \mathrm {d} y} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- a} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- a - 1}}{\mathrm {e} ^ {- a}} = 1 - \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}}.$

questionText: 设随机变量$X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^{2})(\sigma>0)$，记$p=P\{X\leqslant\mu+\sigma^{2}\}$，则（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）令$Y=\frac{X-\mu}{\sigma}$，则由$X\sim N(\mu ,\sigma^{2})$知，$Y\sim N(0,1).$又$p = P \left\{X \leqslant \mu + \sigma^ {2} \right\} = P \left\{\frac {X - \mu}{\sigma} \leqslant \sigma \right\} = P \left\{Y \leqslant \sigma \right\}$故 p与$\mu$的取值无关，且p随着$\sigma$的增加而增加.应选B.

（法二）由于$X\sim N(\mu ,\sigma^2)$，故$\begin{array}{l} p = P \left\{X \leqslant \mu + \sigma^ {2} \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\mu + \sigma^ {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\mu} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {\mu} ^ {\mu + \sigma^ {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {\mu} ^ {\mu + \sigma^ {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - \mu) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = \frac {x - \mu}{\sigma}} \frac {1}{2} + \int_ {0} ^ {\sigma} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} t, \\ \end{array}$从而$p$与$\mu$的取值无关，且$p$随着$\sigma$的增加而增加.应选B.

questionText: 设随机变量 X的概率密度 f(x)满足$f(1+x)=f(1-x)$，且$\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\mathrm{d}x=0.6$，则$P\{ X<0\}=$(    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于$f(1+x)=f(1-x)$，故 f(x)的图像关于 x=1对称.于是，$P\{X<0\}= P\{X>2\}.$又因为$P \{0 \leqslant X \leqslant 2 \} = \int_{0}^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x = 0. 6$，且$P \{X < 0 \} + P \{0 \leqslant X \leqslant 2 \} + P \{X > 2 \} = 1,$所以$P \{ X < 0 \} = \frac {1 - P \{0 \leqslant X \leqslant 2 \}}{2} = \frac {1 - 0 . 6}{2} = 0. 2.$因此，应选A.

（法二）利用换元法.

由于$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} f (x) \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {u = 1 - x} \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {1} f (1 - u) \mathrm {d} (1 - u) &= \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} f (1 - u) \mathrm {d} u \\ \frac {f (1 + u) = f (1 - u)}{\mathrm {二}} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} f (1 + u) \mathrm {d} u &= \int_ {2} ^ {+ \infty} f (t) \mathrm {d} t, \end{aligned}$故$P\{X < 0\} = P\{X > 2\}$.

其余同法一.

questionText: 设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立，且都服从正态分布$N\left(\mu ,\sigma^{2}\right)$，则$P\{|X-Y|<1\}$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由于 X，Y相互独立且都服从正态分布$N(\mu, \sigma^{2})$，故$E(X-Y)=0,D(X-Y)=2\sigma^{2},$$X-Y\sim N(0,2\sigma^{2}).$将 X-Y标准化，可得$\frac{X-Y}{\sqrt{2}\sigma}\sim N(0,1).$，于是，$\begin{array}{l} P \left\{\mid X - Y \mid < 1 \right\} = P \left\{- 1 < X - Y < 1 \right\} = P \left\{\frac {- 1}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} < \frac {X - Y}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} < \frac {1}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} \right\} \\ = \Phi \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2} \sigma}\right) - \Phi \left(\frac {- 1}{\sqrt {2} \sigma}\right) = 2 \Phi \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2} \sigma}\right) - 1. \\ \end{array}$因此，$P\{|X - Y| < 1\}$仅与$\sigma^2$有关.应选A.

questionText: 设随机变量与 Y相互独立， X且$X\sim B\left(1,\frac{1}{3}\right),Y\sim B\left(2,\frac{1}{2}\right)$则$P\{X=Y\}=$___
analysisRich: 解 由于$X\sim B\left(1,\frac{1}{3}\right)$，故$P \left\{X = 0 \right\} = \mathrm {C} _ {1} ^ {0} \left(\frac {1}{3}\right) ^ {0} \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) ^ {1} = \frac {2}{3},$$P \{X = 1 \} = C _ {1} ^ {1} \left(\frac {1}{3}\right) ^ {1} \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) ^ {0} = \frac {1}{3}.$由于$Y\sim B\left(2,\frac{1}{2}\right)$，故$P \left\{Y = 0 \right\} = \mathrm {C} _ {2} ^ {0} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {0} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {1}{4},$$P \left\{Y = 1 \right\} = \mathrm {C} _ {2} ^ {1} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {1} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {1} = \frac {1}{2}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} P \{X = Y \} &= P \{X = 0, Y = 0 \} + P \{X = 1, Y = 1 \} \\ \underline {{\text {独立性}}} P \{X = 0 \} P \{Y = 0 \} + P \{X = 1 \} P \{Y = 1 \} \\ &= \frac {2}{3} \times \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{3} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设随机变量 X,Y相互独立，且 X服从正态分布 N(0,2),Y服从正态分布 N(-2,2).若$P\{2 X+Y< a \}=P\{X>Y\}$，则 a=（    )
analysisRich:
由于$X\sim N(0,2),Y\sim N(-2,2)$，故$E(X) = 0,D(X) = 2,E(Y) = -2,D(Y) = 2$，从而$E (2 X + Y) = E (2 X) + E (Y) = 2 E (X) + E (Y) = - 2,$$D (2 X + Y) = D (2 X) + D (Y) = 4 D (X) + D (Y) = 4 \times 2 + 2 = 1 0,$$E (Y - X) = E (Y) - E (X) = - 2,$$D (Y - X) = D (Y) + D (X) = 4.$于是，$2 X+Y\sim N(-2,1 0), Y-X\sim N(-2,4).$将它们标准化可得$\frac{2 X+Y+2}{\sqrt{1 0}}\sim N(0,1), \frac{Y-X+2}{2}$$\sim N(0,1).$由此可得，$P \left\{2 X + Y < a \right\} = P \left\{2 X + Y \leqslant a \right\} = P \left\{\frac {2 X + Y + 2}{\sqrt {1 0}} \leqslant \frac {a + 2}{\sqrt {1 0}} \right\} = \Phi \left(\frac {a + 2}{\sqrt {1 0}}\right),$$P \{X > Y \} = P \{Y - X < 0 \} = P \{Y - X \leqslant 0 \} = P \left\{\frac {Y - X + 2}{2} \leqslant 1 \right\} = \Phi (1),$其中$\varPhi(x)$是标准正态分布$N(0,1)$的分布函数.

由$P\{2X + Y < a\} = P\{X > Y\}$可得$\varPhi\left(\frac{a + 2}{\sqrt{10}}\right) = \varPhi(1).$又因为$\varPhi(x)$单调增加，所以$\frac{a + 2}{\sqrt{10}} = 1$，即$a = -2 + \sqrt{10}.$因此，应选B.

questionText: 设随机试验每次成功的概率为 p，现进行3次独立重复试验，在至少成功1次的条件下，3次试验全部成功的概率为$\frac{4}{1 3}$，则 p=___
analysisRich: 解设 X为3次独立重复试验中试验成功的次数，则$X\sim B(3,p).$在至少成功1次的条件下， 3次试验全部成功的概率为$P\mid X=3\mid X\geqslant 1\mid =\frac{P\mid X=3,X\geqslant 1\mid}{P\mid X\geqslant 1\mid}=\frac{P\mid X=3\mid}{P\mid X\geqslant 1\mid}=\frac{\mathrm{C}_{3}^{3} p^{3}}{1-\mathrm{C}_{3}^{0}(1-p)^{3}}=\frac{4}{13}.$于是，$\frac{p^{3}}{1-(1-p)^{3}}=\frac{4}{13}.$整理可得$3 p^{3}+4 p^{2}-4 p=0$即$p(p+2)(3 p-2)=0.$由于 p > 0，故 p =$\frac{2}{3}.$

解 由于$X\sim N(0,2),Y\sim N(-1,1)$，故$E(X) = 0,D(X) = 2,E(Y) = -1,D(Y) = 1$，从而$E (Y - 2 X) = E (Y) - 2 E (X) = - 1 - 0 = - 1,$$D (Y - 2 X) = D (Y) + 4 D (X) = 1 + 4 \times 2 = 9,$$E (2 Y - X) = 2 E (Y) - E (X) = 2 \times (- 1) - 0 = - 2,$$D (2 Y - X) = 4 D (Y) + D (X) = 4 \times 1 + 2 = 6.$于是，$Y - 2 X\sim N(-1,9), 2 Y - X\sim N(-2,6).$将它们标准化可得$\frac{Y - 2 X + 1}{3}\sim N(0,1),$$\frac{2 Y - X + 2}{\sqrt{6}}\sim N(0,1).$由此可得，$\begin{array}{l} p _ {1} = P | 2 X - Y > 0 | = P | Y - 2 X < 0 | = P \left\{\frac {Y - 2 X + 1}{3} < \frac {1}{3} \right\} \\ = P \left\{\frac {Y - 2 X + 1}{3} \leqslant \frac {1}{3} \right\} = \Phi \left(\frac {1}{3}\right), \\ \end{array}$$\begin{array}{l} p _ {2} = P \left| X - 2 Y > 1 \right| = P \left| 2 Y - X < - 1 \right| = P \left\{\frac {2 Y - X + 2}{\sqrt {6}} < \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} \right\} \\ = P \left\{\frac {2 Y - X + 2}{\sqrt {6}} \leqslant \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} \right\} = \Phi \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {6}}\right), \\ \end{array}$其中$\varPhi(x)$是标准正态分布的分布函数.

questionText: 设总体 X的分布函数为 F(x),$X_{1}, X_{2}, \dots, X_{n}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本，样本的经验分布函数为$F_{n}(x)$对于给定的 x(0 < F(x) < 1), D(F_{n}(x))=（    )
analysisRich: 解记$X_{i}$的分布函数为$F_{X_{i}}(x).$由于$X_{i} ( i=1,2,\dots,n)$与X同分布，故$F_{X_{i}}(x)=F(x).$令$Y_{i}=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}1,&X_{i}\leqslant x,\\ 0,&X_{i}>x,\end{array}\right. i=1,2,\dots,n$则$Y_{i}$的分布律满足$P \left\{Y _ {i} = 1 \right\} = P \left\{X _ {i} \leqslant x \right\} = F _ {X _ {i}} (x) = F (x),$$P \left\{Y _ {i} = 0 \right\} = P \left\{X _ {i} > x \right\} = 1 - F _ {X _ {i}} (x) = 1 - F (x).$由此可得$Y_{i}\sim B(1,F(x))$.于是，$E \left(Y _ {i}\right) = F (x), \quad D \left(Y _ {i}\right) = F (x) [ 1 - F (x) ].$注意到$F_{n}(x)=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} Y_{i}$，且$Y_{1},Y_{2},\dots ,Y_{n}$独立同分布，故$D \left[ F _ {n} (x) \right] = D \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Y _ {i}\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} D \left(Y _ {i}\right) = \frac {1}{n} D \left(Y _ {i}\right) = \frac {1}{n} F (x) [ 1 - F (x) ].$因此，应选C.

questionText: 设二维随机变量$(X, Y)$服从正态分布$N\left(\mu, \mu; \sigma^2, \sigma^2; 0\right)$, 则$E(XY^2) =$___

questionText: 随机试验 E有三种两两不相容的结果$A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}$，且三种结果发生的概率均为$\frac{1}{3}$，将试验 E独立重复做2次， X表示2次试验中结果$A_{1}$发生的次数，Y表示2次试验中结果$A_{2}$发生的次数，则 X与 Y的相关系数为（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）由题设知，$X\sim B\left(2,\frac{1}{3}\right),Y\sim B\left(2,\frac{1}{3}\right)$，从而$E (X) = E (Y) = 2 \times \frac {1}{3} = \frac {2}{3}, \quad D (X) = D (Y) = 2 \times \frac {1}{3} \times \left(1 - \frac {1}{3}\right) = \frac {4}{9}.$又 XY所有可能的取值为0，1，故$E ( X Y ) = 0 \cdot P \{ X Y = 0 \} + 1 \cdot P \{ X Y = 1 \} = P \{ X = 1, Y = 1 \} = \mathrm {C} _ {2} ^ {1} \times \frac {1}{3} \times \frac {1}{3} = \frac {2}{9},$从而$\rho_{X Y}=\frac{E(X Y)-E(X)E(Y)}{\sqrt{D(X)}\sqrt{D(Y)}}=\frac{\frac{2}{9}-\frac{2}{3}\times \frac{2}{3}}{\frac{4}{9}}=-\frac{1}{2}.$应选A.

（法二）记Z表示2次试验中结果$A_{3}$发生的次数，则$X+Y+Z=2$从而$D (Z) = D (2 - X - Y) = D (X + Y) = D (X) + D (Y) + 2 \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y).$又由题设知，$D ( X )=D ( Y )=D ( Z )$，故$D ( X )=-2\operatorname{C o v} ( X , Y )$，从而$\rho_ {X Y} = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}} = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , Y)}{D (X)} = - \frac {1}{2}.$应选A.

questionText:
设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立，X的概率分布为$P\{X=1\}=P\{X=-1\}=\frac{1}{2},$Y服从参数为$\lambda$的泊松分布.令$Z=XY.$I. 求$\operatorname{Cov}(X,Z)$;

II. 求 Z的概率分布.
answerRich:
(I)$\operatorname{C o v} ( X, Z )=\lambda$;

（Ⅱ）Z的分布律为$P\{Z = i\} = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{\lambda^{i}\mathrm{e}^{- \lambda}}{i!}, & i > 0,\\ \mathrm{e}^{- \lambda}, & i = 0,\\ \frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{\lambda^{-i}\mathrm{e}^{- \lambda}}{(-i)!}, & i < 0. \end{array} \right.$
analysisRich:
解（I）（法一）注意到 X与 Y相互独立，故$X^{2}$与 Y也相互独立根据协方差的计算公式，$\begin{array}{l} \operatorname {C o v} (X, Z) = E (X Z) - E (X) E (Z) \stackrel {Z = X Y} {=} E \left(X ^ {2} Y\right) - E (X) E (X Y) \\ \underline {{\underline {{\text {独立性}}}}} E \left(X ^ {2}\right) E (Y) - \left[ E (X) \right] ^ {2} E (Y). \\ \end{array}$由于 X的概率分布为 P$\{ X=1\}=P\{ X=-1\}=\frac{1}{2}$，故$E (X) = 1 \times \frac {1}{2} + (- 1) \times \frac {1}{2} = 0, \quad E \left(X ^ {2}\right) = 1 ^ {2} \times \frac {1}{2} + (- 1) ^ {2} \times \frac {1}{2} = 1.$又因为$Y$服从参数为$\lambda$的泊松分布，所以$E(Y) = \lambda$因此，$\operatorname {C o v} (X, Z) = E \left(X ^ {2}\right) E (Y) - \left[ E (X) \right] ^ {2} E (Y) = 1 \times \lambda - 0 = \lambda .$（法二）由于$X^{2}=1$，故$XZ=X(XY)=X^{2}Y=Y$，而Y服从参数为$\lambda$的泊松分布，于是，$E(XZ)=E(Y)=\lambda.$由法一可知，$E ( X ) = 0$因此，$\operatorname {C o v} (X, Z) = E (X Z) - E (X) E (Z) = \lambda - 0 = \lambda .$（Ⅱ）由于$Z=XY$，故Z的所有可能的取值为i，其中i为整数.

当 i > 0时，$\begin{aligned} P \{Z = i \} &= P \{X Y = i \} = P \{X = 1, Y = i \} \xlongequal {\text {独立性}} P \{X = 1 \} P \{Y = i \} \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\lambda^ {i} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \lambda}}{i !}. \end{aligned}$当 i = 0时，$P \{Z = 0 \} = P \{X Y = 0 \} \xlongequal {X \text {不 为} 0} P \{Y = 0 \} = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \lambda}.$当 i < 0时，$\begin{aligned} P \{Z = i \} &= P \{X Y = i \} = P \{X = - 1, Y = - i \} \xlongequal {\text {独立性}} P \{X = - 1 \} P \{Y = - i \} \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\lambda^ {- i} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \lambda}}{(- i) !}. \end{aligned}$因此，$Z$的分布律为$P\{Z = i\} = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\lambda^{i}\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda}}{i!}, & i > 0, \\ \mathrm{e}^{-\lambda}, & i = 0, \\ \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\lambda^{-i}\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda}}{(-i)!}, & i < 0. \end{array} \right.$

questionText: 设 X 服从区间$\left(-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$上的均匀分布，$Y=\sin X$，则$\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=$___
analysisRich: 解 由 X服从$\left(-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$上的均匀分布可知，$f(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{\pi},&x\in\left(-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right),\\ 0,&\text{其他}.\end{array}\right.$$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{\pi} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x \mathrm {d} x = 0.$根据协方差的计算公式，$\begin{aligned} \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) &= \operatorname {C o v} (X, \sin X) = E (X \sin X) - E (X) E (\sin X) \xlongequal {E (X) = 0} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \sin x f (x) \mathrm {d} x - 0 \\ &= \frac {1}{\pi} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x \sin x \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x \sin x \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x \mathrm {d} (\cos x) \\ &= - \frac {2}{\pi} \left(x \cos x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos x \mathrm {d} x\right) = - \frac {2}{\pi} \times (0 - 1) = \frac {2}{\pi}. \end{aligned}$

II. 求$Z_{1}$与$Z_{2}$的相关系数.
answerRich:

（Ⅱ）由$Z_{1}, Z_{2}$的联合分布律可知，$P \left\{Z _ {1} = 0 \right\} = \frac {3}{4}, \quad P \left\{Z _ {1} = 1 \right\} = \frac {1}{4};$$P \left\{Z _ {2} = 0 \right\} = \frac {1}{4}, \quad P \left\{Z _ {2} = 1 \right\} = \frac {3}{4};$$P \left\{Z _ {1} Z _ {2} = 0 \right\} = \frac {3}{4}, \quad P \left\{Z _ {1} Z _ {2} = 1 \right\} = \frac {1}{4}.$于是$E ( Z_{1} )=\frac{1}{4}, E ( Z_{1}^{2} )=\frac{1}{4}, D ( Z_{1} )=\frac{3}{1 6}; E ( Z_{2} )=\frac{3}{4}, E ( Z_{2}^{2} )=\frac{3}{4}, D ( Z_{2} )=\frac{3}{1 6};$$E ( Z_{1} Z_{2} )=\frac{1}{4}.$从而$\operatorname {C o v} \left(Z _ {1}, Z _ {2}\right) = E \left(Z _ {1} Z _ {2}\right) - E \left(Z _ {1}\right) E \left(Z _ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{4} - \frac {1}{4} \times \frac {3}{4} = \frac {1}{1 6}.$因此，$Z_{1}$与$Z_{2}$的相关系数$\rho_ {Z _ {1} Z _ {2}} = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} \left(Z _ {1} , Z _ {2}\right)}{\sqrt {D \left(Z _ {1}\right)} \sqrt {D \left(Z _ {2}\right)}} = \frac {\frac {1}{1 6}}{\sqrt {\frac {3}{1 6} \times \frac {3}{1 6}}} = \frac {1}{3}.$

questionText: 甲、乙两个盒子中各装有2个红球和2个白球，先从甲盒中任取一球，观察颜色后放入乙盒中，再从乙盒中任取一球，令 X, Y分别表示从甲盒和乙盒中取到的红球个数，则 X与 Y的相关系数为 ___.
analysisRich:
根据相关系数的计算公式，X与Y的相关系数为$\rho = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}} = \frac {E (X Y) - E (X) E (Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}}.$下面分别计算$X, Y$的分布律与数字特征.

取球模型为等可能模型.$X$的可能取值为0，1. 取到白球，则$X = 0$；取到红球，则$X = 1$$P \{X = 0 \} = \frac {1}{2}, \quad P \{X = 1 \} = \frac {1}{2}.$于是，$E ( X ) = \frac {1}{2}, E \left( X^{2}\right) = \frac {1}{2}, D ( X ) = \frac {1}{2} - \left(\frac {1}{2}\right)^{2} = \frac {1}{4}.$Y的可能取值为0，1.若从甲盒中取出的是白球，则后来乙盒中共有2个红球和3个白球，取到红球的概率为$\frac{2}{5}$即在X=0发生的条件下Y=1发生的概率为$\frac{2}{5}$；若从甲盒中取出的是红球，则后来乙盒中共有3个红球和2个白球，取到红球的概率为$\frac{3}{5}$即在X=1发生的条件下Y=1发生的概率为$\frac{3}{5}.$$\begin{aligned} P \{Y = 1 \} &= P \{Y = 1 \mid X = 0 \} P \{X = 0 \} + P \{Y = 1 \mid X = 1 \} P \{X = 1 \} \\ &= \frac {2}{5} \times \frac {1}{2} + \frac {3}{5} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$$P \{Y = 0 \} = 1 - P \{Y = 1 \} = 1 - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2}.$于是，$E ( Y ) = \frac {1}{2}, E ( Y^{2} ) = \frac {1}{2}, D ( Y ) = \frac {1}{2} - \left(\frac {1}{2}\right)^{2} = \frac {1}{4}.$XY的可能取值为0,1.$P \{X Y = 1 \} = P \{X = 1, Y = 1 \} = P \{Y = 1 \mid X = 1 \} P \{X = 1 \} = \frac {3}{5} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {3}{1 0}.$$P \left\{X Y = 0 \right\} = 1 - \frac {3}{1 0} = \frac {7}{1 0}.$于是，$E ( X Y ) = P \{ X Y = 1 \} \times 1 + P \{ X Y = 0 \} \times 0 = \frac {3}{1 0}.$因此，$\rho = \frac {E (X Y) - E (X) E (Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}} = \frac {\frac {3}{1 0} - \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1}{2}}{\frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1}{2}} = \frac {\frac {1}{2 0}}{\frac {1}{4}} = \frac {1}{5}.$

questionText: 设随机变量 X服从区间（0,3）上的均匀分布，随机变量 Y服从参数为2的泊松分布，且 X与 Y的协方差为 -1，则$D(2X-Y+1)=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由于 X服从区间（0,3）上的均匀分布，故 X的方差$D ( X )=\frac{(3-0)^{2}}{1 2}=\frac{3}{4}.$又由于 Y服从参数为2的泊松分布，故 Y的方差$D ( Y )=2.$由方差的性质，$\begin{aligned} D (2 X - Y + 1) &= D (2 X - Y) = D (2 X) + D (Y) - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (2 X, Y) \\ &= 4 D (X) + D (Y) - 4 \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 4 \times \frac {3}{4} + 2 - 4 \times (- 1) = 9. \end{aligned}$因此，应选C.

questionText: 设随机变量$X\sim N(0,1)$，若在$X=x$的条件下，随机变量$Y\sim N(x,1)$，则 X与Y的相关系数为（    ）
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于$X\sim N(0,1)$，故$X$的概率密度函数为$f _ {X} (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}.$由于在$X = x$的条件下，$Y\sim N(x,1)$，故在$X = x$的条件下，$Y$的条件概率密度为$f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(y - x) ^ {2}}{2}}.$于是，二维随机变量$(X, Y)$的联合概率密度为$f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(y - x) ^ {2}}{2}} = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} + x y - \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}}.$计算$Y$的边缘概率密度$f_{Y}(y)$. 对$y \in (-\infty, +\infty)$，$\begin{aligned} f _ {Y} (y) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{2 \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} + x y - \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{4}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (x - \frac {y}{2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{4}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \sqrt {2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{2 (\sqrt {2}) ^ {2}}}. \end{aligned}$于是，$(X,Y)$关于$Y$的边缘分布是正态分布$N(0,2)$.

结合$f(x,y)$与二维正态分布的概率密度的形式，取$\mu_{1} = 0,\mu_{2} = 0,\sigma_{1} = 1,\sigma_{2} = \sqrt{2}$$\frac {1}{2 \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} + x y - \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}} = \frac {1}{2 \pi \cdot 1 \cdot \sqrt {2} \cdot \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{2}} \left[ \frac {(x - 0) ^ {2}}{1 ^ {2}} - 2 \cdot \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2} \frac {(x - 0) (y - 0)}{1 \cdot \sqrt {2}} + \frac {(y - 0) ^ {2}}{(\sqrt {2}) ^ {2}} \right].$因此，取$\rho = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，则$(X,Y)$服从二维正态分布$N\left(0,0;1,2;\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)$.

由二维正态分布的概率密度的参数的含义可知，$\rho_{X Y}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，应选D.

（法二）计算$\rho_{X Y}.$先计算 E(XY).

由法一可得$f(x,y) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-x^2 + xy - \frac{y^2}{2}}.$于是，$\begin{aligned} E (X Y) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x y f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(y - x) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x \left[ \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} (y - x) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(y - x) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} y + x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(y - x) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} (y - x) \right] \\ &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} (0 + x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x. \end{aligned}$又因为$\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}x^{2}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x = E(X^{2})$，而$X\sim N(0,1)$，所以$E(X^{2}) = D(X) + [E(X)]^{2} = 1.$从而，$E(XY) = 1.$又由法一可得$Y\sim N(0,2)$，故$E(Y)=0,D(Y)=2.$因此，$\rho_ {X Y} = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}} = \frac {E (X Y) - E (X) E (Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)}} = \frac {1 - 0}{\sqrt {2}} = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}.$

questionText: 设随机变量$X\sim N(0,4)$，随机变量$Y\sim B\left(3,\frac{1}{3}\right)$，且 X，Y不相关，则$D(X-3Y+1)=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由于 X~ N（0,4），Y~ B$\left( 3, \frac{1}{3} \right)$，故 X的方差 D（X）=4，Y的方差$D (Y) = 3 \times \frac {1}{3} \times \left(1 - \frac {1}{3}\right) = \frac {2}{3}.$又因为$X, Y$不相关，所以$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = 0.$由方差的性质，$\begin{aligned} D (X - 3 Y + 1) &= D (X - 3 Y) = D (X) + D (3 Y) - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (X, 3 Y) \\ &= D (X) + 9 D (Y) - 6 \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 4 + 9 \times \frac {2}{3} - 0 = 1 0. \end{aligned}$因此，应选D.

questionText:
. (本题满分12分)

设二维随机变量（X，Y）的概率密度为$f ( x, y )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{2}{\pi} \left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right),&x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 1\\ 0,&\text{其它}\end{array} \right.$I. 求 X与 Y的斜方差；

II. 求 X与 Y是否相互独立；

III. 求$Z=X^{2}+Y^{2}$的概率密度.
analysisRich:
解（I）由$f ( x,y )$的定义可知，当$| x | > 1$时，$f ( x,y ) = 0$，当$| x | \leqslant 1$时，$f ( x,y )$仅在$- \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\leqslant y\leqslant \sqrt{1-x^{2}}$时非零.$\begin{aligned} f _ {X} (x) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {- \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} ^ {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} y = \frac {4}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \frac {4}{\pi} \left[ x ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} + \frac {\left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3} \right] = \frac {4}{3 \pi} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \left(1 + 2 x ^ {2}\right), \end{aligned}$即$f_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{4}{3\pi}\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}(1 + 2x^{2}), & |x|\leqslant 1,\\ 0, & |x| > 1. \end{array} \right.$同理可得$f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {4}{3 \pi} \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \left(1 + 2 y ^ {2}\right), & | y | \leqslant 1, \\ 0, & | y | > 1. \end{array} \right.$(a)

(b)

记$D = \{(x,y)\mid x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 1\} .$如图（a）所示，区域D关于x轴，y轴均对称.进一步计算可得$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f _ {X} (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {4 x}{3 \pi} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \left(1 + 2 x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \stackrel {\text {对称性}} {=} 0,$$E (Y) \stackrel {\text {同 理}} {=} 0,$$E (X Y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x y f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D} x y \cdot \frac {2}{\pi} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {\text {对称 性}} {=} 0,$从而$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = E(XY) - E(X)E(Y) = 0.$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问可知，$f_{X}(x)f_{Y}(y)\neq f(x,y)$，故X与Y不相互独立.

（Ⅲ）记$Z = X^{2} + Y^{2}$的分布函数为$F_{Z}(z), D_{z} = \{(x,y)|x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant z\} .$当$z < 0$时，$F_{Z}(z) = P\{Z\leqslant z\} = 0.$当$0 \leqslant z < 1$时，$D \cap D_{z} = D_{z}$，如图（b）所示.$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = \iint_ {D _ {z}} \frac {2}{\pi} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {z}} r ^ {2} \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \\ = \frac {2}{\pi} \cdot 2 \pi \cdot \frac {r ^ {4}}{4} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\sqrt {z}} = z ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}$当$z \geqslant 1$时，$F_{Z}(z) = P\{Z \leqslant z\} = 1.$因此，$Z$的分布函数$F_{Z}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & z < 0,\\ z^{2}, & 0\leqslant z < 1,\\ 1, & z\geqslant 1, \end{array} \right.$概率密度$f_{Z}(z) = F_{Z}^{\prime}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}2z, & 0 < z < 1,\\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$

questionText: 设随机变量 X 与 Y 相互独立，且$X \sim B ( 1, p )$$Y \sim B ( 2, p )$$p \in( 0, 1 )$，则$X+Y$与$X-Y$的相关系数为___.
analysisRich: 解 由$X\sim B(1,p)$可知，$D ( X )=p ( 1-p ).$由$Y\sim B ( 2,p)$可知，$D ( Y )=2 p ( 1-p ).$$X+Y$与$X-Y$的相关系数$\rho=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X+Y,X-Y)}{\sqrt{D(X+Y)}\sqrt{D(X-Y)}}.$由于 X与 Y相互独立，故$D (X + Y) = D (X) + D (Y) = 3 p (1 - p),$$D (X - Y) = D (X) + D (Y) = 3 p (1 - p).$由协方差的性质可得，$\begin{aligned} \operatorname {C o v} (X + Y, X - Y) &= \operatorname {C o v} (X, X) - \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) + \operatorname {C o v} (Y, X) - \operatorname {C o v} (Y, Y) \\ &= D (X) - D (Y) = - p (1 - p). \end{aligned}$因此，$\rho = \frac {- p (1 - p)}{\sqrt {3 p (1 - p)} \sqrt {3 p (1 - p)}} = - \frac {1}{3}.$

questionText: 设随机变量 X的概率密度为$f ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}2(1-x),&0<x<1,\\ 0,&\text{其他}.\end{array}\right.$在 X=x(0<x<1)的条件下，随机变量 Y服从区间 (x,1)上的均匀分布，则$\operatorname{C o v} ( X, Y )=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由于在$X=x(0<x<1)$的条件下，随机变量Y服从区间（x，1）上的均匀分布，故$f_{Y \mid X}(y \mid x)=\frac{1}{1-x}.$记区域$D=\{(x,y)\mid x<y<1,0<x<1\}$，则在区域D上，$(X,Y)$的联合概率密度$\varphi (x, y) = f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) f (x) = \frac {1}{1 - x} \cdot 2 (1 - x) = 2.$注意到区域 D是一个直角边长为1的等腰直角三角形区域，面积为$\frac{1}{2}$，故$\iint_ {D} \varphi (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 1,$从而可认为在$D$以外的区域上，$\varphi (x,y) = 0.$进一步可得，当$0 < y < 1$时，$Y$的边缘概率密度$f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \varphi (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {y} 2 \mathrm {d} x = 2 y.$当$y \leqslant 0$或$y \geqslant 1$时，$f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\varphi(x,y)\mathrm{d}x = 0.$由数学期望的定义可得，$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cdot 2 (1 - x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(2 x - 2 x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \left(x ^ {2} - \frac {2 x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{3},$$E (Y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \cdot 2 y \mathrm {d} y = \left. \frac {2 y ^ {3}}{3} \right| _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {2}{3},$$\begin{aligned} E (X Y) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x y \varphi (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D} 2 x y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {y} x \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \cdot \frac {y ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \left. \frac {y ^ {4}}{4} \right| _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = E (X Y) - E (X) E (Y) = \frac {1}{4} - \frac {1}{3} \times \frac {2}{3} = \frac {1}{3 6}.$应选 D.

questionText: 设随机变量 X服从正态分布 N(-1,1), Y服从正态分布 N(1,2), 若 X与 X+2Y不相关，则 X与 X-Y的相关系数为（    ）
analysisRich: 解 由于 X服从正态分布 N（-1，1），Y服从正态分布 N（1，2），故 D（X）=1，D（Y）=2. 又因为 X与 X+2Y不相关，所以$\operatorname{Cov}(X, X + 2 Y) = \operatorname{Cov}(X, X) + 2 \operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = D (X) + 2 \operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = 1 + 2 \operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = 0.$于是，$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = -\frac{1}{2}.$进一步可得$\operatorname {C o v} (X, X - Y) = \operatorname {C o v} (X, X) - \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = D (X) - \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 1 - \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {3}{2}.$$D (X - Y) = D (X) + D (Y) - 2 \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = 1 + 2 - 2 \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = 4.$因此，X与X-Y的相关系数$\rho = \frac {\operatorname {C o v} (X , X - Y)}{\sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (X - Y)}} = \frac {\frac {3}{2}}{1 \cdot 2} = \frac {3}{4}.$应选 D.

questionText: 设随机变量 X的分布函数为$F(x)=0. 3 \varPhi(x)+0. 7 \varPhi\left(\frac{x-1}{2}\right)$，其中$\varPhi(x)$为标准正态分布的分布函数，则$E(X)=$(    )
analysisRich: 解记$\varphi(x)$为标准正态分布的概率密度函数，则$\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} \varphi(x)\mathrm{d}x=1, \int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} x\varphi(x)\mathrm{d}x=0.$由题设知，X的概率密度为$f(x)=F^{\prime}(x)=0. 3 \varphi(x)+\frac{0. 7}{2} \varphi \left( \frac{x-1}{2} \right)$，于是$\begin{aligned} E (X) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ 0. 3 x \varphi (x) + \frac {0 . 7}{2} x \varphi \left(\frac {x - 1}{2}\right) \right] \mathrm {d} x \\ &= 0 + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {0 . 7}{2} x \varphi \left(\frac {x - 1}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = \frac {x - 1}{2}} 0. 7 \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} (2 t + 1) \varphi (t) \mathrm {d} t \\ &= 0. 7 \left[ 2 \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} t \varphi (t) \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \varphi (t) \mathrm {d} t \right] = 0. 7. \end{aligned}$因此，应选C.

questionText: 设随机变量$X$的概率分布为$P\{X=k\}=\frac{C}{k!}, k=0,1,2,\cdots$，则$E(X^{2})=$___
analysisRich: 由概率的性质可知，$1 = \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {\infty} P \{X = k \} = \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {C}{k !} = C \mathrm {e},$即$C = \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}$. 于是$X$服从参数为1的泊松分布，$E(X) = D(X) = 1$，从而$E \left(X ^ {2}\right) = D (X) + \left[ E (X) \right] ^ {2} = 1 + 1 = 2.$

questionText: 设随机变量 X与 Y相互独立，且都服从参数为1的指数分布. 记$U=\max \{X,Y\}, V=\min \{X,Y\}$I. 求 V的概率密度$f_{V}(v)$II. 求$E(U+V).$
answerRich: (23) （ I ）$f_{V}(v)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}2\mathrm{e}^{-2v},&v>0,\\ 0,&v\leqslant 0; \end{array}\right.$（Ⅱ）2.
analysisRich: 解（I）由题设，随机变量 X, Y的概率密度均为$f ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\mathrm{e}^{-x},&x>0,\\ 0,&\text{其他}.\end{array} \right.$于是 X, Y的分布函数均为$F ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}1-\mathrm{e}^{-x},&x>0,\\ 0,&\text{其他},\end{array} \right.$从而 V的分布函数为$\begin{array}{l} F _ {V} (v) = P \{V \leqslant v \} = 1 - P \{V > v \} = 1 - P \{X > v, Y > v \} \\ = 1 - P \{X > v \} \cdot P \{Y > v \} \\ = 1 - \left[ 1 - F (v) \right] ^ {2} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 v}, & v > 0, \\ 0, & v \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right. \\ \end{array}$因此，V的概率密度为$f _ {V} (v) = F _ {V} ^ {\prime} (v) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 v}, & v > 0, \\ 0, & v \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由于$U + V = \max \{X, Y\} + \min \{X, Y\} = X + Y$，故$E (U + V) = E (X + Y) = E (X) + E (Y) = 2 E (X) = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = 2.$（法二）U的分布函数为$F _ {U} (u) = P \left\{U \leqslant u \right\} = P \left\{X \leqslant u, Y \leqslant u \right\} = P \left\{X \leqslant u \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y \leqslant u \right\} = \left[ F (u) \right] ^ {2}.$于是，U的概率密度为$f _ {U} (u) = F _ {U} ^ {\prime} (u) = 2 F (u) f (u) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- u}\right), & u > 0, \\ 0, & u \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$分别计算$E ( u ) , E ( V )$$E (U) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} u f _ {U} (u) \mathrm {d} u = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 u \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- u} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 u}\right) \mathrm {d} u,$$E (V) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} v f _ {V} (v) \mathrm {d} v = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 v \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 v} \mathrm {d} v.$因此，$E (U + V) = E (U) + E (V) = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 u \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- u} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 u}\right) \mathrm {d} u + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 v \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 v} \mathrm {d} v = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u = 2.$

questionText: 设随机变量$X$服从标准正态分布$N(0,1)$, 则$E(X \mathrm{e}^{2 X}) =$___
analysisRich:
解 由题设知$E \left(X \mathrm {e} ^ {2 X}\right) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 2) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x.$记$E=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{2}}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x.$下面我们用两种方法计算E.

（法一）积分$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}x\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x$可看作服从正态分布N（2,1）的随机变量的数学期望，故$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}x\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x=2.$因此，$E=2\mathrm{e}^{2}.$（法二）$\begin{array}{l} E = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 2) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \left[ \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} (x - 2) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 2) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x + 2 \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 2) ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} x \right] \\ \underline {{= t = x - 2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} t \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} t + \frac {2}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm {d} t\right). \\ \end{array}$由标准正态分布的性质知$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x=1, E(X)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty}x\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x=0.$代入上式可得$E=\mathrm{e}^{2}(0+2)=2\mathrm{e}^{2}.$综上所述，$E\left(X\mathrm{e}^{2X}\right)=E=2\mathrm{e}^{2}.$

设随机变量 X的概率分布为$P\{X=1\}=P\{X=2\}=\frac{1}{2}.$在给定 X=i的条件下，随机变量 Y服从均匀分布$U(0,i)\ (i=1,2).$I. 求 Y的分布函数$F_{Y}(y)$；

II. 求 E(Y).
answerRich: (22) (I)$F_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & y<0, \\ \frac{3}{4} y, & 0\leqslant y<1, \\ \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4} y, & 1\leqslant y<2, \\ 1, & y\geqslant 2; \end{array} \right.$$\frac {3}{4}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）由题设知，当$X = 1$时，$Y\sim U(0,1)$；当$X = 2$时，$Y\sim U(0,2)$.于是，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{Y \leqslant y, X = 1 \right\} + P \left\{Y \leqslant y, X = 2 \right\} \\ = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \mid X = 1 \right\} P \left\{X = 1 \right\} + P \left\{Y \leqslant y \mid X = 2 \right\} P \left\{X = 2 \right\}. \\ \end{array}$当$y < 0$时，$F_{Y}(y)=0\times \frac{1}{2}+0\times \frac{1}{2}=0.$当$0 \leqslant y < 1$时，$F_{Y}(y) = \left(\int_{0}^{y}1\mathrm{d}y\right)\cdot \frac{1}{2} + \left(\int_{0}^{y}\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{d}y\right)\cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{4} y.$当$1\leqslant y < 2$时，$F_{Y}(y) = \left(\int_{0}^{1}1\mathrm{d}y\right)\cdot \frac{1}{2} + \left(\int_{0}^{y}\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{d}y\right)\cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} y.$当$y\geqslant 2$时，$F_{Y}(y) = 1\times \frac{1}{2} +1\times \frac{1}{2} = 1.$因此，$Y$的分布函数为$F_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & y < 0,\\ \frac{3}{4} y, & 0 \leqslant y < 1,\\ \frac{1}{2} +\frac{1}{4} y, & 1 \leqslant y < 2,\\ 1, & y \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问中$Y$的分布函数的表达式知，$Y$的概率密度函数为$f _ {Y} (y) = F _ {Y} ^ {\prime} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {3}{4}, & 0 \leqslant y < 1, \\ \frac {1}{4}, & 1 \leqslant y < 2, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$因此，$E (Y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {3}{4} y \mathrm {d} y + \int_ {1} ^ {2} \frac {1}{4} y \mathrm {d} y = \frac {3}{8} + \frac {3}{8} = \frac {3}{4}.$

questionText:
设随机变量 X的概率密度为$f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 ^ {- x} \ln 2, & x > 0 \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0 \end{array} \right.$对 X 进行独立重复的观测，直到第2个大于3的观测值出现时停止，记 Y为观测次数.

I. 求 Y的概率分布；

II. 求 E(Y).
answerRich: $(2 2) (\mathrm {I}) P \{Y = k \} = \frac {1}{6 4} (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}, k = 2, 3, \dots ;$$(\mathrm {I I}) E (Y) = 1 6.$
analysisRich:
解（I）由题设知，$P \left\{X \leqslant 3 \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {3} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {3} 2 ^ {- x} \ln 2 \mathrm {d} x = - 2 ^ {- x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {3} = - \frac {1}{8} - (- 1) = \frac {7}{8},$$P \{X > 3 \} = 1 - P \{X \leqslant 3 \} = 1 - \frac {7}{8} = \frac {1}{8}.$Y可能的取值为2，3，4，….又由于$Y=k(k\geqslant 2)$意味着前k-1次只有1次出现大于3的观测值，且第k次出现大于3的观测值，故Y的概率分布为$P \left\{Y = k \right\} = \mathrm {C} _ {k - 1} ^ {1} \times \frac {1}{8} \times \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2} \times \frac {1}{8} = \frac {1}{6 4} (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}, \quad k = 2, 3, \dots .$（Ⅱ）（法一）由期望的定义知，$E (Y) = \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k \cdot P \{Y = k \} = \frac {1}{6 4} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}.$考虑幂级数$\sum_{k = 2}^{\infty}k(k - 1)x^{k - 2}$，其收敛域为（-1，1），故该级数在$x = \frac{7}{8}$处收敛.当$x\in(-1,1)$时，$\begin{aligned} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) x ^ {k - 2} &= \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} \left(x ^ {k}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} x ^ {k}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {2} - 1 + 1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} \\ &= \left(- x - 1 + \frac {1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {2}{(1 - x) ^ {3}}. \end{aligned}$因此，$E (Y) = \frac {1}{6 4} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2} = \frac {1}{6 4} \times \frac {2}{\left(1 - \frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {3}} = 1 6.$（法二）利用几何分布的性质.

设$Y_{1}$表示出现第1个大于3的观测值时所需的观测次数，$Y_{2}$表示出现第1个大于3的观测值之后到出现第2个大于3的观测值时所需的观测次数，则$Y = Y_{1} + Y_{2}$，且$Y_{1}, Y_{2}$均服从参数为$p = \frac{1}{8}$的几何分布.于是$E\left(Y_{1}\right) = E\left(Y_{2}\right) = \frac{1}{p} = 8.$因此，$E (Y) = E \left(Y _ {1}\right) + E \left(Y _ {2}\right) = 1 6.$

设随机变量 X的概率密度为$f ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}2^{-x}\ln 2,&x>0,\\ 0,&x\leqslant 0.\end{array} \right.$对 X 进行独立重复的观测，直到第2个大于3的观测值出现时停止，记 Y为观测次数.

I. 求 Y的既率分布；

II. 求 E(Y).
answerRich: (22) （I）Y的概率分布为$P \{Y = k \} = \frac {1}{6 4} (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}, \quad k = 2, 3, 4, \dots ;$
analysisRich:
解（ I ）由题设知，$P \left\{X \leqslant 3 \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {3} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {3} 2 ^ {- x} \ln 2 \mathrm {d} x = - 2 ^ {- x} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {3} = - \frac {1}{8} - (- 1) = \frac {7}{8},$$P \{X > 3 \} = 1 - P \{X \leqslant 3 \} = 1 - \frac {7}{8} = \frac {1}{8}.$Y可能的取值为2，3，4，….又由于$Y=k(k\geqslant 2)$意味着前k-1次只有1次出现大于3的观测值，且第k次出现大于3的观测值，故Y的概率分布为$P \{Y = k \} = C _ {k - 1} ^ {1} \times \frac {1}{8} \times \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2} \times \frac {1}{8} = \frac {1}{6 4} (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}, \quad k = 2, 3, 4, \dots .$（Ⅱ）（法一）由期望的定义知，$E (Y) = \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k \cdot P \{Y = k \} = \frac {1}{6 4} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2}.$考虑幂级数$\sum_{k = 2}^{\infty}k(k - 1)x^{k - 2}$，其收敛域为（-1，1），故该级数在$x = \frac{7}{8}$处收敛.当$x\in(-1,1)$时，$\begin{aligned} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) x ^ {k - 2} &= \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} \left(x ^ {k}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} x ^ {k}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {2} - 1 + 1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} \\ &= \left(- x - 1 + \frac {1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {1}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {2}{(1 - x) ^ {3}}. \end{aligned}$因此，$E (Y) = \frac {1}{6 4} \sum_ {k = 2} ^ {\infty} k (k - 1) \left(\frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {k - 2} = \frac {1}{6 4} \times \frac {2}{\left(1 - \frac {7}{8}\right) ^ {3}} = 1 6.$（法二）利用几何分布的性质.

设$Y_{1}$表示出现第1个大于3的观测值时所需的观测次数，$Y_{2}$表示出现第1个大于3的观测值之后到出现第2个大于3的观测值时所需的观测次数，则$Y=Y_{1}+Y_{2}$，且$Y_{1},Y_{2}$均服从参数为$p=\frac{1}{8}$的几何分布.于是$E\left(Y_{1}\right)=E\left(Y_{2}\right)=\frac{1}{p}=8.$因此，$E (Y) = E \left(Y _ {1}\right) + E \left(Y _ {2}\right) = 1 6.$

questionText: 设总体$X$的概率密度为$f (x; \theta) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {3 x ^ {2}}{\theta^ {3}}, & 0 < x < \theta , \\ 0, & \text {其 他}, \end{array} \right.$其中$\theta\in(0,+\infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1},X_{2},X_{3}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本，令$T=\max\{X_{1},X_{2},X_{3}\}$I. 求 T的概率密度； II. 确定 a，使得$E(aT)=\theta.$
answerRich: （I）$f_{T}(t)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{9 t^{8}}{\theta^{9}},&0<t<\theta,\\ 0,&\text{其他};\end{array}\right.$（Ⅱ）当 a$=\frac{10}{9}$时，$E(aT)=\theta.$
analysisRich:
解（I）设 T的分布函数为$F_{T}(t), T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t).$由于$X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本，故它们相互独立且与 X同分布.从而$\begin{array}{l} F _ {T} (t) = P \{T \leqslant t \} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant t, X _ {2} \leqslant t, X _ {3} \leqslant t \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant t \right\} \cdot P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant t \right\} \cdot P \left\{X _ {3} \leqslant t \right\} \\ = \left[ P \left\{X \leqslant t \right\} \right] ^ {3} = \left[ F _ {X} ^ {\prime} (t) \right] ^ {3}, \\ \end{array}$其中$F_{X}(t)$为X的分布函数.

下面用两种方法求$f_{T}(t)$（法一）先求$F_{T}(t)$，再求导得到$f_{T}(t)$当$t < 0$时，$F_{X}(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x;\theta)\mathrm{d}x = 0.$于是$F_{T}(t) = \left[ F_{X}(t)\right]^{3} = 0.$当$0 \leqslant t < \theta$时，$F_{X}(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x; \theta)\mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{t}\frac{3x^{2}}{\theta^{3}}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{t^{3}}{\theta^{3}}.$于是$F_{T}(t) = [F_{X}(t)]^{3} = \frac{t^{9}}{\theta^{9}}.$当$t \geqslant \theta$时，$F_{X}(t) = 1.$于是$F_{T}(t) = \left[ F_{X}(t) \right]^{3} = 1.$因此，$F _ {T} (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & t < 0, \\ \frac {t ^ {9}}{\theta^ {9}}, & 0 \leqslant t < \theta , \\ 1, & t \geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$综上所述，$T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t) = F_{T}^{\prime}(t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{9t^{8}}{\theta^{9}}, & 0 < t < \theta ,\\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（法二）直接求导得到$f_{T}(t)$后再求解.$f _ {T} (t) = F _ {T} ^ {\prime} (t) = 3 F _ {X} ^ {\prime} (t) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2} = 3 f (t; \theta) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2}.$当$t < 0$时，$f(t; \theta) = 0.$于是$f_{T}(t) = 0.$当$0\leqslant t < \theta$时，$F_{X}(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{t} f(x;\theta)\mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{t}\frac{3x^{2}}{\theta^{3}}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{t^{3}}{\theta^{3}}.$于是$f _ {T} (t) = 3 f (t; \theta) \left[ F _ {X} (t) \right] ^ {2} = 3 \cdot \frac {3 t ^ {2}}{\theta^ {3}} \cdot \left(\frac {t ^ {3}}{\theta^ {3}}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {9 t ^ {8}}{\theta^ {9}}.$当$t \geqslant \theta$时，$f(t; \theta) = 0.$于是$f_{T}(t) = 0.$综上所述，$T$的概率密度为$f_{T}(t)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{9 t^{8}}{\theta^{9}},&0<t<\theta ,\\ 0,&\text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）由第（Ⅰ）问中所求结果知，$E (a T) = a E (T) = a \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} t f _ {T} (t) \mathrm {d} t = a \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} \frac {9 t ^ {9}}{\theta^ {9}} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {9 a}{1 0 \theta^ {9}} t ^ {1 0} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} = \frac {9}{1 0} a \theta .$要使$E ( a T)=\theta$，则$\frac{9}{10} a\theta =\theta$，解得$a=\frac{10}{9}.$因此，当$a = \frac{10}{9}$时，$E(aT) = \theta .$

设随机变量 X，Y相互独立，且 X的概率分布为$P\{X=0\}=P\{X=2\}=\frac{1}{2},$Y的概率密度为$f (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 y, & 0 < y < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$I. 求$P\{Y\leqslant E(Y)\}$；

II. 求$Z=X+Y$的概率密度
answerRich: （I）$\frac{4}{9}$$(\mathrm {I I}) f _ {Z} (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} z, & 0 < z < 1, \\ z - 2, & 2 < z < 3, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$
analysisRich:
解（I）由题设知，$E ( Y )=\int_{- \infty}^{+ \infty} y f ( y ) \mathrm{d} y=\int_{0}^{1} 2 y^{2} \mathrm{d} y=\frac{2}{3}.$因此，$P \left\{Y \leqslant E (Y) \right\} = P \left\{Y \leqslant \frac {2}{3} \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{3}} 2 y \mathrm {d} y = \frac {4}{9}.$（Ⅱ）Z的分布函数为$\begin{aligned} F _ {Z} (z) &= P \{Z \leqslant z \} = P \{X + Y \leqslant z \} \\ &= P \{X + Y \leqslant z, X = 0 \} + P \{X + Y \leqslant z, X = 2 \} \\ &= P \{Y \leqslant z, X = 0 \} + P \{Y \leqslant z - 2, X = 2 \} \\ \underline {{\underline {{X , Y \text {相 互 独立}}}}} P \{Y \leqslant z \} \cdot P \{X = 0 \} + P \{Y \leqslant z - 2 \} \cdot P \{X = 2 \} \\ &= \frac {1}{2} P \{Y \leqslant z \} + \frac {1}{2} P \{Y \leqslant z - 2 \}. \end{aligned}$下面用两种方法求 Z的概率密度.

（法一）如图所示，当$z\leqslant 0$时，$F_{Z}(z) = 0 + 0 = 0.$当$0 < z\leqslant 1$时，$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{z}2y\mathrm{d}y + 0 = \frac{z^{2}}{2}$.

当$1 < z\leqslant 2$时，$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}2y\mathrm{d}y + 0 = \frac{1}{2}.$当$2 < z\leqslant 3$时，$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2} +\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{z - 2}2y\mathrm{d}y = \frac{1}{2} +\frac{(z - 2)^{2}}{2}.$当$z > 3$时，$F_{Z}(z) = 1.$综上所述，Z的概率密度为$f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} z, & 0 < z < 1, \\ z - 2, & 2 < z < 3, \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$（法二）由$Z$的分布函数$F_{Z}(z) = \frac{1}{2} P\{Y \leqslant z\} +\frac{1}{2} P\{Y \leqslant z - 2\}$知，$Z$的概率密度为$f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \frac {1}{2} f (z) + \frac {1}{2} f (z - 2).$当$z\leqslant 0$时，$z - 2\leqslant 0,f_Z(z) = 0 + 0 = 0.$当$0 < z < 1$时，$z - 2\leqslant 0,f_Z(z) = \frac{1}{2}\cdot 2z + 0 = z.$当$1\leqslant z\leqslant 2$时，$z - 2\leqslant 0,f_Z(z) = 0 + 0 = 0.$当$2 < z < 3$时，$0 < z - 2 < 1$，$f_{Z}(z) = 0 + \frac{1}{2}\cdot 2(z - 2) = z - 2.$当$z\geqslant 3$时，$z - 2\geqslant 1, f_Z(z) = 0 + 0 = 0.$综上所述，$f_{z}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} z, & 0 < z < 1, \\ z - 2, & 2 < z < 3, \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right.$

questionText: 设随机变量 X的概率密度为 f(x)$\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{x}{2},&0<x<2,\\0,&\text{其他},\end{array}\right.$F(x)为 X的分布函数，E(X)为 X的数学期望，则$P\{F(X)>E(X)-1\}=$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）分别计算$E ( X )$，$F ( x )$$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} x = \left. \frac {x ^ {3}}{6} \right| _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {4}{3}.$当$x < 0$时，$F ( x )=0.$当$0 \leqslant x < 2$时，$F(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{x} f(t)\mathrm{d}t = \int_{0}^{x}\frac{t}{2}\mathrm{d}t = \frac{x^2}{4}$.

当$x\geqslant 2$时，$F(x) = 1.$于是，$F ( x ) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & x < 0, \\ \frac{x^{2}}{4}, & 0 \leqslant x < 2, \\ 1, & x \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$因此，$\begin{array}{l} P \left\{F (X) > E (X) - 1 \right\} = P \left\{F (X) > \frac {1}{3} \right\} = P \left\{\frac {X ^ {2}}{4} > \frac {1}{3}, 0 \leqslant X < 2 \right\} + P \left\{X \geqslant 2 \right\} \\ = P \left\{\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} < X < 2 \right\} + \int_ {2} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = 1 - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}}} \frac {x}{2} \mathrm {d} x + 0 \\ = 1 - \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}}} = \frac {2}{3}. \\ \end{array}$（法二）我们先证明$Y = F(X)$服从（0，1）上的均匀分布.

注意到$F ( x )$在（0，2）上严格单调增加，其值域为（0，1），故可定义$F^{-1}(y)$，$y\in(0,1).$考虑Y的分布函数$F_{Y}(y).$当$y < 0$时，由于$F(X)$仅在$[0,1]$上取值，故$F_{Y}(y) = 0.$当$0\leqslant y < 1$时，$F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{F (X) \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X \leqslant F ^ {- 1} (y) \right\} = F \left(F ^ {- 1} (y)\right) = y.$当$y \geqslant 1$时，$P\{Y \leqslant y\} = 1$，即$F_{Y}(y) = 1.$因此，$F_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & y < 0,\\ y, & 0\leqslant y < 1,\\ 1, & y\geqslant 1. \end{array} \right.$这说明$Y = F(X)$服从（0，1）上的均匀分布.

由法一可知$E ( X )=\frac{4}{3}$故$P \left\{F (X) > E (X) - 1 \right\} = P \left\{F (X) > \frac {1}{3} \right\} = 1 - P \left\{F (X) \leqslant \frac {1}{3} \right\} = 1 - \frac {1}{3} = \frac {2}{3}.$

（法一）分别计算$E ( X )$，$F ( x )$$E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {x ^ {3}}{6} \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {4}{3}.$当$x < 0$时，$F ( x )=0.$当$0 \leqslant x < 2$时，$F(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{x} f(t)\mathrm{d}t = \int_{0}^{x}\frac{t}{2}\mathrm{d}t = \frac{x^2}{4}.$当$x\geqslant 2$时，$F(x) = 1.$于是，$F ( x ) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & x < 0, \\ \frac{x^{2}}{4}, & 0 \leqslant x < 2, \\ 1, & x \geqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$因此，$\begin{array}{l} P \left\{F (X) > E (X) - 1 \right\} = P \left\{F (X) > \frac {1}{3} \right\} = P \left\{\frac {X ^ {2}}{4} > \frac {1}{3}, 0 \leqslant X < 2 \right\} + P \left\{X \geqslant 2 \right\} \\ = P \left\{\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} < X < 2 \right\} + \int_ {2} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = 1 - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}}} \frac {x}{2} \mathrm {d} x + 0 \\ = 1 - \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}}} = \frac {2}{3}. \\ \end{array}$（法二）我们先证明$Y=F(X)$服从（0，1）上的均匀分布.

注意到 F(x)在（0，2）上严格单调增加，其值域为（0，1），故可定义$F^{-1}(y), y\in(0,1).$考虑 Y的分布函数$F_{Y}(y).$当$y < 0$时，由于$F ( X )$仅在[0，1]上取值，故$F_{Y} ( y )=0.$当$0\leqslant y < 1$时，$F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{F (X) \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X \leqslant F ^ {- 1} (y) \right\} = F \left(F ^ {- 1} (y)\right) = y.$当$y \geqslant 1$时，$P\{Y \leqslant y\} = 1$，即$F_{Y}(y) = 1.$因此，$F_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0,& y<0,\\ y,& 0\leqslant y<1,\\ 1,& y\geqslant 1. \end{array} \right.$这说明$Y=F(X)$服从（0，1）上的均匀分布.

由法一可知$E ( X )=\frac{4}{3}$，故$P \left\{F (X) > E (X) - 1 \right\} = P \left\{F (X) > \frac {1}{3} \right\} = 1 - P \left\{F (X) \leqslant \frac {1}{3} \right\} = 1 - \frac {1}{3} = \frac {2}{3}.$

questionText: 设随机变量$X$的概率分布为$P\{X=k\}=\frac{1}{2^{k}}(k=1,2,3,\cdots),Y$表示$X$被3除的余数，则$E(Y)=$___.
analysisRich:
解 X的取值为全体正整数，而 Y表示 X被3除的余数，故 Y的可能取值为0，1，2，分别对应 X = 3i+3, X=3i+1, X=3i+2（i=0，1，2，…）的情况.

下面计算 Y的分布律.$P \{Y = 0 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} P \{X = 3 i + 3 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{2 ^ {3 i + 3}} = \frac {1}{8} \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}},$$P \{Y = 1 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} P \{X = 3 i + 1 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{2 ^ {3 i + 1}} = \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}},$$P \{Y = 2 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} P \{X = 3 i + 2 \} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{2 ^ {3 i + 2}} = \frac {1}{4} \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}}.$根据期望的定义，$\begin{array}{l} E (Y) = 0 \times P \{Y = 0 \} + 1 \times P \{Y = 1 \} + 2 \times P \{Y = 2 \} \\ = 1 \times \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}} + 2 \times \frac {1}{4} \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}} = \sum_ {i = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{8 ^ {i}} \\ = \frac {1}{1 - \frac {1}{8}} = \frac {8}{7}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText:
在区间（0,2）上随机取一点，将该区间分成两段，较短一段的长度为 X，较长一段的长度为 Y，令$Z=\frac{Y}{X}$.

I. 求 X的概率密度；

II. 求 Z的概率密度；

III. 求$E\left(\frac{X}{Y}\right).$
answerRich: （I）$X$的概率密度为$f_{X}(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}1,&0<x<1,\\ 0,&\text{其他};\end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）$Z$的概率密度为$f_{Z}(z)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}0,&z<1,\\ \frac{2}{(z+1)^{2}},&z\geqslant 1; \end{array} \right.$（Ⅲ）$2\ln 2-1.$
analysisRich:
解（I）根据分析，在区间（0，2）上随机取一点，将该点位置记为 W，则 W服从（0，2）上的均匀分布.$X=\min \{ W,2-W\}$由于$X$为较短一段的长度，故$X$的取值范围为（0,1].

记$X$的分布函数为$F_{X}(x)$当$x < 0$时，$F_{X}(x) = P\{X\leqslant x\} = 0.$当$0\leqslant x < 1$时，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {X} (x) = P \{X \leqslant x \} = 1 - P \{X > x \} = 1 - P \{W > x, 2 - W > x \} \\ = 1 - P \left\{x < W < 2 - x \right\} = 1 - P \left\{W < 2 - x \right\} + P \left\{W \leqslant x \right\} \\ = 1 - \frac {2 - x}{2} + \frac {x}{2} = x. \\ \end{array}$当$x\geqslant 1$时，$F_{X}(x) = P\{X\leqslant x\} = 1.$因此，$F_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & x < 0,\\ x, & 0\leqslant x < 1, f_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}1, & 0 < x < 1,\\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{array} \right. X$服从区间（0,1）上的均匀分布.$1, x \geqslant 1,$（Ⅱ）$Z=\frac{Y}{X}=\frac{2-X}{X}=\frac{2}{X}-1.$记Z的分布函数为$F_{Z}(z).$由于$X$的取值范围为$(0,1]$，故$Z$的取值范围为$[1, + \infty)$.

当$z < 1$时，$F_{Z}(z) = P\{Z\leqslant z\} = 0.$当$z\geqslant 1$时，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \left\{\frac {2}{X} - 1 \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{\frac {2}{X} \leqslant z + 1 \right\} = P \left\{X \geqslant \frac {2}{z + 1} \right\} \\ = 1 - P \left\{X < \frac {2}{z + 1} \right\}. \\ \end{array}$由于$P\left\{X < \frac{2}{z + 1}\right\} = \frac{2}{z + 1}$，故$F_{Z}(z) = 1 - \frac{2}{z + 1}$因此，$F_{Z}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & z < 1, \\ 1 - \frac{2}{z + 1}, & z \geqslant 1. \end{array} \right. f_{Z}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & z < 1, \\ \frac{2}{(z + 1)^{2}}, & z \geqslant 1. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅲ）（法一）注意到$\frac{X}{Y}=\frac{X}{2-X}.$$\begin{aligned} E \left(\frac {X}{Y}\right) &= E \left(\frac {X}{2 - X}\right) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{2 - x} \cdot f _ {X} (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x}{2 - x} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(- 1 + \frac {2}{2 - x}\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \left[ - x - 2 \ln (2 - x) \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = 2 \ln 2 - 1. \end{aligned}$（法二）由于$Z = \frac{Y}{X}$，故$\frac{X}{Y} = \frac{1}{Z}$.于是，$E \left(\frac {X}{Y}\right) = E \left(\frac {1}{Z}\right) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{z} \cdot f _ {Z} (z) \mathrm {d} z = 2 \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {1}{(z + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} z.$设$\frac{1}{z(z + 1)^2} = \frac{A}{z} +\frac{B}{z + 1} +\frac{C}{(z + 1)^2}$，则$\frac {1}{z (z + 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {A (z + 1) ^ {2} + B z (z + 1) + C z}{z (z + 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {(A + B) z ^ {2} + (2 A + B + C) z + A}{z (z + 1) ^ {2}}.$比较系数可得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} A+B=0, \\ 2 A+B+C=0, \\ A=1. \end{array} \right.$解得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} A=1, \\ B=-1, \\ C=-1. \end{array} \right.$从而$\frac{1}{z(z+1)^2}=\frac{1}{z}-\frac{1}{z+1}-\frac{1}{(z+1)^2}.$$\begin{aligned} E \left(\frac {X}{Y}\right) &= 2 \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{z} - \frac {1}{z + 1} - \frac {1}{(z + 1) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm {d} z = 2 \left(\ln \frac {z}{z + 1} + \frac {1}{z + 1}\right) \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \\ &= 2 \left(0 - \ln \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2}\right) = 2 \ln 2 - 1. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设随机变量 X服从参数为1的泊松分布，则$E[|X - E(X)|] =$（    ）
analysisRich: 归于 X服从参数为1的泊松分布，故$E ( X )=1.$从而$| X - E (X) | = | X - 1 | = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & X = 0, \\ X - 1, & X = 1, 2, \dots . \end{array} \right.$由参数为1的泊松分布的分布律可知，$P\{X = 0\} = \frac{1^{0}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{0!} = \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}.$根据数学期望的定义，$\begin{aligned} E [ \mid X - E (X) \mid ] &= 1 \cdot P \{X = 0 \} + \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {\infty} (k - 1) P \{X = k \} \\ &= \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} + \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {\infty} (k - 1) P \{X = k \} - (0 - 1) P \{X = 0 \} \\ &= \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} + E (X - 1) + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} = \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} + E (X) - 1 + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} \\ \underline {{\underline {{E (X) = 1}}}} \frac {2}{\mathrm {e}}. \end{aligned}$因此，应选C.

answerRich: （I）$X$的分布函数$F_{X}(x)=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{x}};$（Ⅱ）$Y$的概率密度为$f_{Y}(y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{(1+y)^{2}},&y>0,\\ 0,&y\leqslant 0.\end{array}\right.$（Ⅲ）Y的数学期望不存在.
analysisRich:
解（ I ）记 X的分布函数为$F_{X}(x).$由概率密度的定义可知，$F _ {X} (x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {x} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {t}}{\left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {t}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \xlongequal {=} \int_ {0} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}} \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{\left(1 + u\right) ^ {2}} = \frac {- 1}{1 + u} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}.$（Ⅱ）（法一）定义法.

计算$Y$的分布函数$F_{Y}(y)$由于$Y=\mathrm{e}^{X}>0$，故当$y\leqslant0$时，$F_{Y}(y)=P\{Y\leqslant y\}=0.$当 y > 0时，$F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{\mathrm {e} ^ {X} \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X \leqslant \ln y \right\} = F _ {X} (\ln y) = \frac {y}{1 + y}.$因此，$F_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{y}{1+y},&y>0,\\ 0,&y\leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$当 y > 0时，$f_{Y}(y)=F_{Y}^{\prime}(y)=\frac{1}{(1+y)^{2}}.$当 y≤0时，$f_{Y}(y)$$= F_{Y}^{\prime}(y)=0.$综上所述，Y的概率密度为$f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{(1 + y) ^ {2}}, & y > 0, \\ 0, & y \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$（法二）公式法.

函数$g ( x )=\mathrm{e}^{x}$在$(-\infty, +\infty)$上处处可导且$g^{\prime}(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x}>0.$$\alpha = \min \left\{g (- \infty), g (+ \infty) \right\} = 0, \beta = \max \left\{g (- \infty), g (+ \infty) \right\} = + \infty .$$g(x)$的反函数为$x = \ln y, (\ln y)^{\prime} = \frac{1}{y}$.

由公式法可得，当 y > 0时，$f _ {Y} (y) = f _ {X} (\ln y) \left| \frac {1}{y} \right| = \frac {1}{y} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\ln y}}{\left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {\ln y}\right) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{y} \cdot \frac {y}{(1 + y) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{(1 + y) ^ {2}}.$当$y\leqslant0$时，$f_{Y}(y)=0.$因此，Y的概率密度为$f_{Y}(y)=\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{(1+y)^{2}},&y>0,\\ 0,&y\leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅲ）若 Y的数学期望存在，则由数学期望的定义可知$\begin{array}{l} E (Y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {y \mathrm {d} y}{(1 + y) ^ {2}} = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1 + y - 1}{(1 + y) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{1 + y} - \frac {1}{(1 + y) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm {d} y = \left[ \ln (1 + y) + \frac {1}{1 + y} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = + \infty . \\ \end{array}$因此，E（Y）不存在.

questionText: 设随机变量 X的概率密度为$f ( x )=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}6 x(1-x),&0<x<1,\\0,&\text{其他},\end{array}\right.$则 X的三阶中心矩$E \left\{ \left[ X-E ( X ) \right]^{3} \right\}=(\quad)$
analysisRich: 解 根据数学期望的定义，$\begin{aligned} E (X) &= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cdot 6 x (1 - x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(6 x ^ {2} - 6 x ^ {3}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \left. \left(2 x ^ {3} - \frac {3 x ^ {4}}{2}\right) \right| _ {0} ^ {1} \\ &= 2 - \frac {3}{2} = \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$进一步可得，$\begin{array}{l} E \left\{\left[ X - E (X) \right] ^ {3} \right\} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {3} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {3} \cdot 6 x (1 - x) \mathrm {d} x \\ \underline {{=}} t = x - \frac {1}{2} 6 \int_ {- \frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} t ^ {3} \cdot \left(t + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(\frac {1}{2} - t\right) \mathrm {d} t = 6 \int_ {- \frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} t ^ {3} \left(\frac {1}{4} - t ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} t \\ = 6 \int_ {- \frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {1}{4} t ^ {3} - t ^ {5}\right) \mathrm {d} t \stackrel {\text {对称性}} {=} 0. \\ \end{array}$因此，应选B.
