questionText: 设总体 X服从$[0,\theta]$上的均匀分布，$\theta\in(0,+\infty)$为未知参数，$X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$为来自总体 X的简单随机样本，记为$X_{(n)}=\max\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\}, T_{c}=cX_{(n)}.$I. 求 c，使得$E\left(T_{c}\right)=\theta;$II. 记 h(c)=E$[\left(T_{c}-\theta\right)^{2}]$，求 c使得 h(c)最小.
analysisRich:
（I）由于 X服从$[0,\theta]$上的均匀分布，故 X的分布函数为$F _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & x < 0, \\ \frac {x}{\theta}, & 0 \leqslant x < \theta , \\ 1, & x \geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$记随机变量$Y = X_{(n)} = \max \left|X_{1},X_{2},\dots ,X_{n}\right|$. 计算$Y$的分布函数$F_{Y}(y)$当$y < 0$时，$F_{Y}(y) = 0.$当$0\leqslant y < \theta$时，$\begin{array}{l} F _ {Y} (y) = P \left\{Y \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{\max _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} X _ {i} \leqslant y \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant y, X _ {2} \leqslant y, \dots , X _ {n} \leqslant y \right\} \\ \underline {{\text {独立 性}}} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant y \right\} P \left\{X _ {2} \leqslant y \right\} \dots P \left\{X _ {n} \leqslant y \right\} = F _ {X} ^ {n} (y) = \left(\frac {y}{\theta}\right) ^ {n}. \\ \end{array}$当$y\geqslant \theta$时，$F_{Y}(y) = 1.$于是，$F_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0, & y < 0, \\ \left(\frac{y}{\theta}\right)^{n}, & 0 \leqslant y < \theta , \\ 1, & y \geqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$对$F_{\gamma}(y)$求导，可得$f _ {Y} (y) = F _ {Y} ^ {\prime} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}}, & 0 < y < \theta , \\ 0, & \text {其 他}. \end{array} \right.$因此，$\begin{aligned} E \left(T _ {c}\right) &= E (c Y) = c \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y \cdot f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = c \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} y \cdot \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}} \mathrm {d} y = c \cdot \frac {n}{\theta^ {n}} \cdot \frac {y ^ {n + 1}}{n + 1} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} \\ &= \frac {c n}{n + 1} \theta . \end{aligned}$若$E\left(T_{c}\right) = \theta$，则$\frac{cn}{n + 1}\theta = \theta$，解得$c = \frac{n + 1}{n}$.

（Ⅱ）展开 h（c）可得$h (c) = E \left[ \left(T _ {c} - \theta\right) ^ {2} \right] = E \left[ \left(c Y - \theta\right) ^ {2} \right] = c ^ {2} E \left(Y ^ {2}\right) - 2 c \theta E (Y) + \theta^ {2}.$计算$E ( Y^{2})$$E \left(Y ^ {2}\right) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} \cdot f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {\theta} y ^ {2} \cdot \frac {n y ^ {n - 1}}{\theta^ {n}} \mathrm {d} y = \frac {n}{\theta^ {n}} \cdot \frac {y ^ {n + 2}}{n + 2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\theta} = \frac {n}{n + 2} \theta^ {2}.$于是，$h (c) = c ^ {2} \cdot \frac {n}{n + 2} \theta^ {2} - 2 c \cdot \frac {n}{n + 1} \theta^ {2} + \theta^ {2} = \left(\frac {n}{n + 2} c ^ {2} - \frac {2 n}{n + 1} c + 1\right) \theta^ {2}.$令$\frac{\mathrm{d}[h(c)]}{\mathrm{d}c}=\left(\frac{2 n}{n+2} c-\frac{2 n}{n+1}\right)\theta^{2}=0$，解得 c =$\frac{n+2}{n+1}.$该点是 h(c）的唯一驻点. 又因为$h^{\prime \prime}(c)=\frac{2 n}{n+2}\theta^{2}>0$，所以该唯一驻点是 h(c）的极小值点，也是最小值点.

因此，当$c=\frac{n+2}{n+1}$时，$h(c)$最小.

questionText: 设二维随机变量 (X,Y) 服从正态分布 N(0,0;1,1;$\rho$), 其中$\rho \in(-1,1)$, 若 a,b为满足$a^{2}+b^{2}=1$的任意实数，则 D(aX+bY) 的最大值为（    )
analysisRich:
解 由于$(X, Y)$服从正态分布$N(0, 0; 1, 1; \rho)$，故$D (X) = D (Y) = 1, \quad \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) = \rho \sqrt {D (X)} \sqrt {D (Y)} = \rho .$根据方差的性质，$\begin{aligned} D (a X + b Y) &= D (a X) + D (b Y) + 2 \operatorname {C o v} (a X, b Y) = a ^ {2} D (X) + b ^ {2} D (Y) + 2 a b \operatorname {C o v} (X, Y) \\ &= a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} + 2 a b \rho \xlongequal {a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} = 1} 1 + 2 a b \rho . \end{aligned}$又因为$a^2 + b^2 = 1 \geqslant 2 |ab|$，所以$1 + 2ab\rho \leqslant 1 + 2|ab\rho| \leqslant 1 + |\rho|$，从而$D(aX + bY) \leqslant$1+$| \rho |$. 若$\rho > 0$，则 D（aX+bY）的最大值为1+$\rho$，最大值在$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a=\pm \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, \\ b=\pm \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \end{array} \right.$时取得；若$\rho < 0$，则 D（aX+

bY）的最大值为$1 - \rho$，最大值在时取得；若$\rho = 0$，则$D(aX + bY)\equiv 1.$因此，$D ( a X+b Y )$的最大值为$1+|\rho|$，应选C.

questionText: 设随机变量 $X\sim N(1,2)$，$f(t)=E[(X+t)^2]$，则 $f(t)$ 的最小值点与最小值为（　）。
analysisRich: $E[(X+t)^2]=\operatorname{Var}(X)+(E(X)+t)^2=2+(1+t)^2$。故最小值在 $t=-1$ 处取得，最小值为 $2$，选 C。

questionText: 随机变量 $X\sim N(0,1)$，随机变量 $Y\sim B(2,\frac12)$，且 $X$ 与 $Y$ 独立，则 $XY$ 与 $X+Y$ 的相关系数为（　）。
analysisRich: 独立性及 $E(X)=0$ 给出 $\operatorname{Cov}(XY,X+Y)=E(X^2)E(Y)=1$。又 $\operatorname{Var}(XY)=E(X^2)E(Y^2)=3/2$，$\operatorname{Var}(X+Y)=1+1/2=3/2$。相关系数为 $1/(\sqrt{3/2}\sqrt{3/2})=2/3$，选 C。
